bookInfo.name: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
bookInfo.author: Sima Guang

sentences.zh: 資治通鑑 第253卷 。

translations.literal: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 253.
translations.idiomatic: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 253

sentences.zh: 【唐紀六十九】 起強圉作噩，盡上章困敦十月，凡三年有奇。

translations.literal: [Tang Records 69] From Qiangyu Zuoe through Shangzhang Kundun, tenth month; a little over three years in all.
translations.idiomatic: [Tang Records 69] From Qiangyu Zuoe through Shangzhang Kundun, tenth month—a little over three years in all

sentences.zh: 僖宗聖恭定孝皇帝上之下乾符四年（丁酉，公元八七七年） 。

translations.literal: Emperor Xizong the Sagely, Respectful, Settled, and Filial—lower part of the Upper Annals—Qianfu year 4 (dingyou, 877 CE).
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xizong the Sagely, Respectful, Settled, and Filial—lower portion of the Upper Annals—Qianfu year 4 (dingyou, 877 CE)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，王郢誘寔入舟中，執之，將士從寔者皆奔潰。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, Wang Ying lured Shi into the boat, seized him, and the officers and soldiers who had followed Shi all fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, Wang Ying lured Shi into his boat, seized him, and the officers and soldiers who had followed Shi all broke and fled

sentences.zh: 朝廷聞之，以右龍武大將軍宋皓為江南諸道招討使，先征諸道兵外，更發忠武、宣武、感化三道、宣、泗二州兵，新舊合萬五千餘人，並受皓節度。

translations.literal: When the court heard of this, it appointed Right Dragon Martial Grand General Song Hao as Pacification Commissioner for the Jiangnan circuits; besides troops levied from the various circuits in advance, it further mobilized armies from the Zhongwu, Xuanwu, and Ganhua circuits and from Xu and Si prefectures—old and new together more than fifteen thousand men—all placed under Hao's command.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing this, the court appointed Right Dragon Martial Grand General Song Hao pacification commissioner for the Jiangnan circuits. Besides troops already levied from the circuits, it sent further forces from Zhongwu, Xuanwu, and Ganhua and from Xu and Si prefectures—more than fifteen thousand men in all, old and new combined—all under Hao's command

sentences.zh: 二月，郢攻陷望海鎮，掠明州，又攻台州，陷之；

translations.literal: In the second month, Ying captured Wanghai garrison, plundered Ming prefecture, and again attacked Taizhou and took it;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Ying captured Wanghai garrison, plundered Mingzhou, then attacked Taizhou and took it;

sentences.zh: 刺史王葆退守唐光。

translations.literal: the prefect Wang Bao withdrew to defend Tangguang.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wang Bao withdrew to hold Tangguang

sentences.zh: 詔二浙、福建各出舟師以討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Two Zhes and Fujian each to dispatch naval forces to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Two Zhes and Fujian each to dispatch fleets against him

sentences.zh: 王仙芝陷鄂州。

translations.literal: Wang Xianzhi captured E prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xianzhi captured Ezhou

sentences.zh: 黃巢陷鄆州，殺節度使薛崇。

translations.literal: Huang Chao captured Yan prefecture and killed Military Governor Xue Chong.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao captured Yanzhou and killed military governor Xue Chong

sentences.zh: 南詔酋龍嗣立以來，為邊患殆二十年，中國為之虛耗，而其國中亦疲弊。

translations.literal: Since Chief Long Sili of Nanzhao came to the throne, he had been a border menace for nearly twenty years; China was drained on his account, and his own state was also exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Since Nanzhao's Chief Long Sili had come to the throne, he had been a border scourge for nearly twenty years; China was drained fighting him, and his own kingdom was worn out as well

sentences.zh: 酋龍卒，謚曰景莊皇帝；

translations.literal: Chief Long died; his posthumous title was Emperor Jingzhuang;
translations.idiomatic: Chief Long died and was given the posthumous title Emperor Jingzhuang;

sentences.zh: 子法立，改元貞明承智大同，國號鶴拓，亦號大封人。

translations.literal: his son Fa succeeded; he changed the era name to Zhenming Chengzhi Datong, took the state name Hezhe, and was also called the Great Feng people.
translations.idiomatic: his son Fa succeeded him, changed the era name to Zhenming Chengzhi Datong, took the state name Hezhe, and was also styled the Great Feng people

sentences.zh: 法好畋獵酣飲，委國事於大臣。

translations.literal: Fa loved hunting and heavy drinking and entrusted state affairs to his great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Fa loved hunting and carousing and left state affairs to his senior ministers

sentences.zh: 閏月，嶺南西首節度使辛讜奏南詔遣阤西段瑳寶等來請和，且言「諸道兵戍邕州歲久，饋餉之費，疲弊中國，請許其和，使贏瘵息肩。」

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, Lingnan West Circuit military governor Xin Dan memorialized that Nanzhao had sent Tuo Xi Duan Chibao and others to sue for peace, and moreover said, "Troops from the various circuits garrisoning Yong prefecture for many years—the cost of supplies has worn out China; we ask that peace be granted so the wasted and afflicted may rest their shoulders."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, Lingnan West Circuit military governor Xin Dan reported that Nanzhao had sent Tuo Xi Duan Chibao and others to sue for peace, adding that troops from the circuits had garrisoned Yongzhou for years at ruinous cost to the empire and begging that peace be granted so the realm might catch its breath

sentences.zh: 詔許之。

translations.literal: An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved

sentences.zh: 讜遣大將杜弘等繼書幣，送瑳寶還南詔，但留荊南、宣歙數軍戍邕州，自餘諸道兵什減其七。

translations.literal: Dan sent the great generals Du Hong and others with further letters and gifts, escorted Chibao back to Nanzhao, but kept only several armies from Jingnan and Xuanshe to garrison Yong prefecture; of the remaining circuit troops, seven-tenths were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Dan sent Generals Du Hong and others with further letters and gifts and escorted Chibao back to Nanzhao, but kept only a few Jingnan and Xuanshe units to garrison Yongzhou and cut the other circuit garrisons by seven-tenths

sentences.zh: 王郢橫行浙西，鎮海節度使裴璩嚴兵設備，不與之戰，密招其黨朱實降之，散其徒六七千人，輸器械二十餘萬，舟航、粟帛稱是。

translations.literal: Wang Ying rampaged through western Zhe; Zhenhai military governor Pei Yu kept his troops in strict readiness and did not give battle, but secretly induced his follower Zhu Shi to surrender, dispersed his band of six or seven thousand, and delivered more than two hundred thousand weapons, with boats, grain, and cloth in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ying rampaged across western Zhejiang. Zhenhai military governor Pei Yu held his forces in readiness without giving battle, secretly won over Ying's follower Zhu Shi, dispersed six or seven thousand of Ying's men, and turned in more than two hundred thousand weapons, with boats, grain, and cloth to match

sentences.zh: 敕以實為金吾將軍。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Shi as Golden Guard general.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Shi a Golden Guard general

sentences.zh: 於是郢黨離散。

translations.literal: Thereupon Ying's faction scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Ying's followers then scattered

sentences.zh: 郢收餘眾，東至明州，甬橋鎮遏使劉巨容以筒箭射殺之，餘黨皆平。

translations.literal: Ying gathered the remnant host, went east to Ming prefecture, and Yongqiao garrison commander Liu Jurong killed him with a tube-arrow; the remaining bandits were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Ying rallied his remnants and went east to Mingzhou, where Yongqiao garrison commander Liu Jurong killed him with a bolt from a tube-bow; the rest of his band was wiped out

sentences.zh: 璩，諝之從曾孫也。

translations.literal: Yu was a great-great-grandson of Xu in the collateral line.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was a great-great-grandson of Xu Yan, by a collateral line of descent

sentences.zh: 三月，黃巢陷沂州。

translations.literal: In the third month, Huang Chao captured Yi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Huang Chao captured Yizhou

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，壬申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the renshen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the renshen new moon, the sun was eclipsed

sentences.zh: 賊帥柳彥璋剽掠江西。

translations.literal: The bandit chief Liu Yanzhang plundered Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chief Liu Yanzhang plundered Jiangxi

sentences.zh: 陝州軍亂，逐觀察使崔碣；

translations.literal: The Shaan prefecture army mutinied and expelled observation commissioner Cui Jie;
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanzhou garrison mutinied and drove out observation commissioner Cui Jie;

sentences.zh: 貶碣杯州司馬。

translations.literal: Jie was demoted to prefectural aide of Bei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jie was demoted to prefectural aide at Beizhou

sentences.zh: 黃巢與尚讓合兵保查牙山。

translations.literal: Huang Chao and Shang Rang combined their forces and held Chaya Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao and Shang Rang united their forces and held Chaya Mountain

sentences.zh: 五月，甲子，以給事中楊損為陝虢觀察使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiazi, Supervising Secretary Yang Sun was appointed Shaan-Guo observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiazi, supervising secretary Yang Sun was appointed Shaan-Guo observation commissioner

sentences.zh: 損至官，誅首亂者。

translations.literal: When Sun reached his post, he executed the ringleaders of the mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: When Sun took office, he executed the ringleaders of the mutiny

sentences.zh: 損，嗣復之子也。

translations.literal: Sun was a son of Sifu.
translations.idiomatic: Sun was a son of Yang Sifu

sentences.zh: 初，桂管觀察使李瓚失政，支使薛堅石屢規正之，瓚不能從。

translations.literal: Earlier, Guiguan observation commissioner Li Zan had misgoverned; staff supervisor Xue Jianshi repeatedly admonished and corrected him, but Zan could not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Guiguan observation commissioner Li Zan had misgoverned; staff supervisor Xue Jianshi had repeatedly tried to correct him, but Zan would not listen

sentences.zh: 及瓚被逐，堅石攝留務，移牒鄰道，禁遏亂兵，一方以安。

translations.literal: When Zan was driven out, Jianshi took charge of remaining affairs, sent dispatches to neighboring circuits, and restrained mutinous troops; the region was thereby pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When Zan was driven out, Jianshi took charge of affairs, notified neighboring circuits, and checked the mutinous troops, and the region was pacified

sentences.zh: 詔擢堅石為國子博士。

translations.literal: An edict promoted Jianshi to Erudite of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted Jianshi to Erudite of the National University

sentences.zh: 六月，柳彥璋襲陷江州，執刺史陶祥，使祥上表，彥璋亦自附降狀。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Liu Yanzhang raided and captured Jiang prefecture, seized prefect Tao Xiang, made Xiang submit a memorial, and Yanzhang himself also submitted a petition to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Liu Yanzhang raided and took Jiangzhou, seized prefect Tao Xiang, made Xiang submit a memorial to the throne, and Yanzhang himself sent in a surrender petition as well

sentences.zh: 敕以彥璋為右監門將軍，令散眾赴京師。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Yanzhang Right Gate Guard general and ordered him to disperse his followers and proceed to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Yanzhang Right Gate Guard general and ordered him to disband his men and come to the capital

sentences.zh: 以左武衛將軍劉秉仁為江州刺史。

translations.literal: Left Martial Guard general Liu Bingren was appointed prefect of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: Left Martial Guard general Liu Bingren was appointed prefect of Jiangzhou

sentences.zh: 彥璋不從，以戰艦百餘固湓江為水寨，剽掠如故。

translations.literal: Yanzhang did not obey; with more than a hundred warships he fortified the Xun River as a water camp and plundered as before.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhang refused. With more than a hundred warships he fortified a camp on the Xun River and went on plundering as before

sentences.zh: 忠武都將李可封戍邊還，至邠州，迫脅主帥，索舊欠糧鹽，留止四月，闔境震驚。

translations.literal: Zhongwu commandery general Li Kefeng returned from garrison duty on the frontier; reaching Bin prefecture, he coerced the commander, demanded back pay in grain and salt, and remained four months—the whole circuit was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongwu commandery general Li Kefeng returned from frontier garrison duty. At Binzhou he coerced the commander, demanded back pay in grain and salt, and stayed four months, throwing the whole circuit into alarm

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，還至許州，節度命名崔安潛悉按誅之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, when he returned to Xu prefecture, military governor Cui Anqian had them all investigated and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, when they reached Xuzhou, military governor Cui Anqian had them all investigated and executed

sentences.zh: 庚申，王仙芝、黃巢攻宋州，三道兵與戰，不利，賊遂圍宋威於宋州。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Wang Xianzhi and Huang Chao attacked Song prefecture; troops from three circuits fought them but fared ill, and the bandits then besieged Song Wei in Song prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Xianzhi and Huang Chao attacked Songzhou. Troops from three circuits fought them without success, and the rebels then besieged Song Wei in Songzhou

sentences.zh: 甲寅，右威衛上將軍張自勉將忠武兵七千救宋州，殺賊二千餘人，賊解圍遁去。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Right Martial Guard senior general Zhang Zimian led seven thousand Zhongwu troops to relieve Song prefecture, killed more than two thousand bandits, and the bandits lifted the siege and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Right Martial Guard senior general Zhang Zimian led seven thousand Zhongwu troops to relieve Songzhou, killed more than two thousand rebels, and the rebels broke the siege and fled

sentences.zh: 王鐸、盧攜欲使張自勉以所將兵受宋威節度，鄭畋以為威與自勉已有疑忿，若在麾下，必為所殺，不肯署奏。

translations.literal: Wang Duo and Lu Xie wished Zhang Zimian to place the troops he led under Song Wei's command; Zheng Tian held that Wei and Zimian already bore mutual suspicion and resentment, and that if placed under him, Zimian would surely be killed—he refused to countersign the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Duo and Lu Xie wanted Zhang Zimian's troops placed under Song Wei's command. Zheng Tian argued that Wei and Zimian already distrusted each other and that Zimian would be killed if placed under Wei; he refused to countersign the memorial

sentences.zh: 八月，辛未，鐸、攜訴於上，求罷免；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinwei, Duo and Xie appealed to the emperor and asked to be dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinwei, Duo and Xie appealed to the throne and asked to be dismissed;

sentences.zh: 庚辰，畋請歸滻川養疾；

translations.literal: on gengchen, Tian asked to return to Chanchuan to nurse his illness;
translations.idiomatic: on gengchen, Tian asked to retire to Chanchuan to recover his health;

sentences.zh: 上皆不許。

translations.literal: the emperor would not permit any of it.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor refused all of them

sentences.zh: 王仙芝陷安州。

translations.literal: Wang Xianzhi captured An prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xianzhi captured Anzhou

sentences.zh: 鹽州軍亂，逐刺史王承顏，詔高品牛從珪往慰諭之，貶承顏象州司戶。

translations.literal: The Yan prefecture army mutinied and expelled prefect Wang Chengyan; an edict sent high-ranking official Niu Conggui to console and instruct them, and Chengyan was demoted to registrar of Xiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yanzhou garrison mutinied and drove out prefect Wang Chengyan. An edict sent high-ranking official Niu Conggui to reassure the troops and demoted Chengyan to registrar of Xiangzhou

sentences.zh: 承顏及崔碣素有政聲，以嚴肅為驕卒所逐，朝廷與貪暴致亂者同貶，時人惜之。

translations.literal: Chengyan and Cui Jie had long enjoyed a reputation for good government; because their severity led arrogant soldiers to expel them, the court demoted them the same as men who had stirred disorder through greed and violence—contemporaries lamented this.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyan and Cui Jie had long been known for good government, yet the court demoted them along with corrupt officials who had caused mutinies—because their severity had provoked unruly troops—and contemporaries deplored it

sentences.zh: 從珪自鹽州還，軍中請以大將王宗誠為刺史。

translations.literal: When Conggui returned from Yan prefecture, the army asked that great general Wang Zongcheng be made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: When Conggui returned from Yanzhou, the troops asked that senior general Wang Zongcheng be made prefect

sentences.zh: 詔宗誠詣闕，將士皆釋罪，仍如優給。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zongcheng to come to court; officers and soldiers were all pardoned and still received generous treatment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned Zongcheng to court, pardoned the officers and soldiers, and continued their generous allowances

sentences.zh: 乙卯，王仙芝陷隨州，執刺史崔休征。

translations.literal: On yimao, Wang Xianzhi captured Sui prefecture and seized prefect Cui Xiuzheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Wang Xianzhi captured Suizhou and seized prefect Cui Xiuzheng

sentences.zh: 山南東道節度使李福遣其子將兵救隨州，戰死。

translations.literal: Shannan East Circuit military governor Li Fu sent his son with troops to relieve Sui prefecture; he died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Shannan East Circuit military governor Li Fu sent his son with troops to relieve Suizhou; the son was killed in battle

sentences.zh: 福奏求援兵，遣左武衛大將軍李昌言將鳳翔五百騎赴之，仙芝遂轉掠復、郢。

translations.literal: Fu memorialized requesting reinforcements; Left Martial Guard grand general Li Changyan was sent with five hundred Fengxiang cavalry to go to his aid, and Xianzhi then turned to plunder Fu and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Fu asked for reinforcements. Left Martial Guard grand general Li Changyan was sent with five hundred Fengxiang horsemen, but Xianzhi turned aside to plunder Fu and Ying prefectures

sentences.zh: 忠武大將張貫等四千人與宣武兵援襄州，自申、蔡間道逃歸。

translations.literal: Zhongwu great general Zhang Guan and four thousand others, with Xuanwu troops aiding Xiang prefecture, fled back by secret routes through Shen and Cai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongwu general Zhang Guan and four thousand men, together with Xuanwu troops sent to aid Xiangzhou, slipped back through the byways of Shen and Cai

sentences.zh: 詔忠武節度使崔安潛、宣武節度使穆仁裕遣人約還。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhongwu military governor Cui Anqian and Xuanwu military governor Mu Renyu to send men to summon them back.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zhongwu military governor Cui Anqian and Xuanwu military governor Mu Renyu to send envoys and bring them back

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，邠寧節度使李侃奏遣兵討王宗誠，斬之，餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Binning military governor Li Kan memorialized that he had dispatched troops to attack Wang Zongcheng, beheaded him, and pacified the remaining faction entirely.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, Binning military governor Li Kan reported that he had sent troops against Wang Zongcheng, beheaded him, and wiped out the rest of his followers

sentences.zh: 鄭畋與王鐸、盧攜爭論用兵於上前，畋不勝，退，復上奏，以為：「自王仙芝俶擾，崔安潛首請會兵討之，繼發士卒，罄供資糧。

translations.literal: Zheng Tian debated military employment with Wang Duo and Lu Xie before the emperor; Tian did not prevail, withdrew, and again submitted a memorial, stating: "Since Wang Xianzhi first stirred up trouble, Cui Anqian was the first to request combined armies to attack him, and thereafter sent troops, exhausting supplies and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tian debated troop deployment with Wang Duo and Lu Xie before the emperor and lost. He withdrew and submitted another memorial arguing that since Wang Xianzhi had first risen in revolt, Cui Anqian had been first to call for a joint campaign, had sent troops repeatedly, and had exhausted his supplies

sentences.zh: 賊往來千里，塗炭諸州，獨不敢犯其境。

translations.literal: The bandits ranged a thousand li back and forth, ravaging the prefectures, yet dared not invade his territory alone.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels ranged a thousand li and ravaged prefecture after prefecture, yet never dared enter his circuit

sentences.zh: 又以本道兵援張自勉，解宋州圍，使江、淮漕運流通，不輸寇手。

translations.literal: He also used his circuit's troops to aid Zhang Zimian, lifted the siege of Song prefecture, kept Jiang-Huai grain transport flowing, and did not let it fall into the bandits' hands.
translations.idiomatic: He had also sent his own troops to reinforce Zhang Zimian, lifted the siege of Songzhou, and kept Jiang-Huai grain transport flowing so nothing fell into rebel hands

sentences.zh: 今蒙盡以自勉所將七千兵令張貫將之，隸宋威。

translations.literal: Now he has been obliged to give all seven thousand troops Zimian led to Zhang Guan to command and place them under Song Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Now every one of the seven thousand men Zhang Zimian had led is given to Zhang Guan and placed under Song Wei

sentences.zh: 自勉獨歸許州，威復奏加誣毀。

translations.literal: Zimian returned alone to Xu prefecture, and Wei again memorialized with further slander.
translations.idiomatic: Zimian came back to Xuzhou alone, while Wei filed fresh charges against him

sentences.zh: 因功受辱，臣竊痛之。

translations.literal: To suffer insult after meritorious service—I am privately pained at this.
translations.idiomatic: To be rewarded with insult after real service—this pains me deeply

sentences.zh: 安潛出師，前後克捷非一，一旦強兵盡付它人，良將空還，若勍敵忽至，何以枝梧！

translations.literal: Anqian took the field repeatedly and won victories more than once; in a single stroke his strong army was all handed to others and his good generals returned empty—if a formidable foe should suddenly arrive, how could he brace himself!
translations.idiomatic: Anqian had campaigned again and again with repeated victories; now his best troops are given away and his best generals sent home empty-handed—if a strong enemy strikes suddenly, how will he resist?

sentences.zh: 臣請以忠武四千人授威，餘三千人使自勉將之，守衛其境，既不侵宋威之功，又免使安潛愧恥。」

translations.literal: Your servant asks that four thousand Zhongwu troops be given to Wei, and the remaining three thousand be left for Zimian to lead in guarding his territory—thus neither encroaching on Song Wei's merit nor making Anqian suffer shame."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that four thousand Zhongwu troops be assigned to Wei and the remaining three thousand left with Zimian to guard his circuit—so Wei's credit is untouched and Anqian is spared disgrace

sentences.zh: 時盧攜不以為然，上不能決。

translations.literal: At the time Lu Xie did not agree, and the emperor could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xie disagreed, and the emperor could not decide

sentences.zh: 畋復上言：「宋威欺罔朝廷，敗衄狼藉。

translations.literal: Tian again submitted: "Song Wei has deceived and misled the court; his defeats are in disarray.
translations.idiomatic: Tian submitted again: "Song Wei has deceived the court; his defeats are a shambles

sentences.zh: 又聞王仙芝七狀請降，威不為聞奏。

translations.literal: It is also heard that Wang Xianzhi seven times petitioned to surrender, and Wei did not report it to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: I also hear that Wang Xianzhi sent seven petitions offering to surrender, and Wei never reported them

sentences.zh: 朝野切齒，以為宜正軍法。

translations.literal: Court and countryside grind their teeth and hold that military law should be applied.
translations.idiomatic: Court and country alike demand that he face military justice

sentences.zh: 跡狀如此，不應復典兵權，願與內大臣參酌，早行罷黜。」

translations.literal: With a record such as this, he ought not again to hold military authority; I wish to consult with inner ministers and remove him early."
translations.idiomatic: With a record like this he should not command troops again. I beg that you consult the inner ministers and dismiss him at once

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: The request was not followed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not agree

sentences.zh: 河中軍亂，逐節度使劉侔，縱兵焚掠。

translations.literal: The Hezhong army mutinied, expelled military governor Liu You, and let the troops burn and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong garrison mutinied, drove out military governor Liu You, and burned and plundered at will

sentences.zh: 以京兆尹竇璟為河中宣慰制置使。

translations.literal: Capital Magistrate Dou Yu was appointed Hezhong pacification and disposition commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Capital magistrate Dou Yu was appointed Hezhong pacification and disposition commissioner

sentences.zh: 黃巢寇掠蘄、黃，曾元裕擊破之，斬首四千餘級。

translations.literal: Huang Chao raided Qi and Huang; Zeng Yuanyu defeated him and cut off more than four thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao raided Qi and Huang prefectures. Zeng Yuanyu defeated him and took more than four thousand heads

sentences.zh: 巢遁去。

translations.literal: Chao fled.
translations.idiomatic: Chao fled

sentences.zh: 十一月，己酉，以竇璟為河中節度使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, Dou Yu was appointed Hezhong military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, Dou Yu was appointed Hezhong military governor

sentences.zh: 招討副使、都監楊復光遣人說諭王仙芝，仙芝遣尚君長等請降於復光，宋威遣兵於道中劫取君長等。

translations.literal: Pacification vice-commissioner and overall supervisor Yang Fuguang sent men to persuade Wang Xianzhi; Xianzhi sent Shang Junzhang and others to request surrender to Fuguang, and Song Wei dispatched troops on the road to seize Junzhang and the others.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification vice-commissioner and overall supervisor Yang Fuguang sent envoys to win over Wang Xianzhi. Xianzhi sent Shang Junzhang and others to offer surrender to Fuguang, but Song Wei sent troops to intercept Junzhang and his party on the road

sentences.zh: 十二月，威奏與君長等戰於穎州西南，生擒以獻；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wei memorialized that he had fought Junzhang and the others southwest of Ying prefecture and captured them alive to present;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Wei reported that he had fought Junzhang and his party southwest of Yingzhou and presented them as live captives;

sentences.zh: 復光奏君長等實降，非威所擒。

translations.literal: Fuguang memorialized that Junzhang and the others had in fact surrendered and were not captured by Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Fuguang countered that Junzhang and the others had actually surrendered and were not Wei's prisoners

sentences.zh: 詔侍御史歸仁紹等鞫之，竟不能明。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Attending Censor Gui Renshao and others to investigate; in the end the matter could not be clarified.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered attending censor Gui Renshao and others to investigate, but the truth could not be established

sentences.zh: 斬君長等於狗脊嶺。

translations.literal: Junzhang and the others were beheaded at Gouji Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Junzhang and his companions were executed at Gouji Ridge

sentences.zh: 黃巢陷匡城，遂陷濮州。

translations.literal: Huang Chao captured Kuangcheng and then captured Pu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao took Kuangcheng and then captured Puzhou

sentences.zh: 詔穎州刺史張自勉將諸道兵擊之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Ying prefecture governor Zhang Zimian to lead troops from the various circuits to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yingzhou prefect Zhang Zimian to lead allied troops against him

sentences.zh: 江州刺史劉秉仁乘驛之官，單舟入柳彥璋水。

translations.literal: Jiang prefecture governor Liu Bingren traveled by post relay to his post and entered Liu Yanzhang's waters alone in a single boat.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangzhou prefect Liu Bingren traveled by post relay to take office and sailed alone into Liu Yanzhang's river stronghold

sentences.zh: 賊出不意，即迎拜，秉仁斬彥璋，散其眾。

translations.literal: The bandits, caught unawares, at once came out to welcome and bow; Bingren beheaded Yanzhang and dispersed his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Taken by surprise, the rebels came out to greet him; Bingren beheaded Yanzhang and dispersed his men

sentences.zh: 王仙芝寇荊南。

translations.literal: Wang Xianzhi raided Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xianzhi raided Jingnan

sentences.zh: 節度使楊知溫，知至之兄也，以文學進，不知兵，或告賊至，知溫以為妄，不設備。

translations.literal: Military governor Yang Zhiwen, elder brother of Zhiwei, had advanced through literary accomplishment and knew nothing of war; when someone reported that bandits had arrived, Zhiwen thought it false and made no preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Military governor Yang Zhiwen, elder brother of Yang Zhiwei, had risen through letters and knew nothing of war. When told the rebels were coming, he dismissed it as rumor and made no preparations

sentences.zh: 時漢水淺狹，賊自賈塹度。

translations.literal: At the time the Han River was shallow and narrow; the bandits crossed from Jia Dam.
translations.idiomatic: The Han River was then shallow and narrow, and the rebels crossed at Jia Dam

sentences.zh: 僖宗聖恭定孝皇帝上之下乾符五年（戊戌，公元八七八年） 。

translations.literal: Emperor Xizong the Sagely, Respectful, Settled, and Filial—lower part of the Upper Annals—Qianfu year 5 (wuxu, 878 CE).
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xizong the Sagely, Respectful, Settled, and Filial—lower portion of the Upper Annals—Qianfu year 5 (wuxu, 878 CE)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，丁酉朔，大雪，知溫方受賀，賊已至城下，遂陷羅城。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the dingyou new moon, heavy snow fell; Zhiwen was just receiving congratulations when the bandits had already reached below the walls, and they then took the outer city.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on the dingyou new moon, heavy snow fell. Zhiwen was still receiving New Year congratulations when the rebels were already at the walls and took the outer city

sentences.zh: 將佐共治子城而守之，及暮，知溫猶不出。

translations.literal: His officers together repaired the inner city and held it; by evening Zhiwen still had not come out.
translations.idiomatic: His officers rallied to hold the inner citadel, but by evening Zhiwen still had not shown himself

sentences.zh: 將佐請知溫出撫士卒，知溫紗帽皁裘而行；

translations.literal: The officers asked Zhiwen to come out and encourage the troops; Zhiwen went forth in gauze cap and black fur robe;
translations.idiomatic: They begged him to come out and rally the men. He appeared in gauze cap and black fur robe;

sentences.zh: 將佐請知溫擐甲以備流矢，知溫見士卒拒戰，猶賦詩示幕僚，遣使告急於山南東道節度使李福，福悉其眾自將救之。

translations.literal: the officers asked Zhiwen to don armor against stray arrows; Zhiwen, seeing the soldiers resisting in battle, still composed poetry to show his staff, sent envoys in urgent appeal to Shannan East Circuit military governor Li Fu, and Fu led all his forces in person to rescue him.
translations.idiomatic: they asked him to don armor against stray arrows. Seeing the men fighting, he still composed poetry for his staff, sent an urgent appeal to Shannan East military governor Li Fu, and Fu marched in person with his entire force to relieve the city

sentences.zh: 時有沙陀五百在襄陽，福與之俱至荊門，遇賊，沙陀縱騎奮擊，破之。

translations.literal: At the time five hundred Shatuo were at Xiangyang; Fu went with them to Jingmen, met the bandits, and the Shatuo let loose their horsemen in fierce attack and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred Shatuo horsemen were then at Xiangyang. Fu brought them to Jingmen, met the rebels, and the Shatuo cavalry charged and broke them

sentences.zh: 仙芝聞之，焚掠江陵而去。

translations.literal: When Xianzhi heard of this, he burned and plundered Jiangling and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhi heard this, burned and plundered Jiangling, and withdrew

sentences.zh: 江陵城下舊三十萬戶，至是死者什三四。

translations.literal: Below Jiangling city there had formerly been three hundred thousand households; by this time three or four in ten had died.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangling had once held three hundred thousand households below the walls; now three or four in ten were dead

sentences.zh: 壬寅，招討副使曾元裕大破王仙芝於申州東，所殺萬人，招降散遣者亦萬人。

translations.literal: On renyin, pacification vice-commissioner Zeng Yuanyu greatly defeated Wang Xianzhi east of Shen prefecture, killing ten thousand men and also receiving the surrender and dispersal of ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, pacification vice-commissioner Zeng Yuanyu routed Wang Xianzhi east of Shenzhou, killing ten thousand rebels and accepting the surrender and dispersal of another ten thousand

sentences.zh: 敕以宋威久病，罷招討使，還青州。

translations.literal: An edict, because Song Wei had long been ill, removed him as pacification commissioner and returned him to Qing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict relieved the long-ill Song Wei of his pacification command and sent him back to Qingzhou

sentences.zh: 以曾元裕為招討使，穎州刺史張自勉為副使。

translations.literal: Zeng Yuanyu was made pacification commissioner and Ying prefecture governor Zhang Zimian vice-commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Yuanyu was made pacification commissioner and Yingzhou prefect Zhang Zimian his deputy

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以西川節度使高駢為荊南節度使兼鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Xichuan military governor Gao Pian was appointed Jingnan military governor and concurrently salt and iron transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Xichuan military governor Gao Pian was appointed Jingnan military governor and concurrent salt and iron transport commissioner

sentences.zh: 振武節度使李國昌之子克用為沙陀副兵馬使，戍蔚州。

translations.literal: Zhenwu military governor Li Guochang's son Keyong was Shatuo deputy military commissioner and garrisoned Wei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenwu military governor Li Guochang's son Li Keyong was Shatuo deputy military commissioner, garrisoned at Weizhou

sentences.zh: 時河南盜賊蜂起，雲州沙陀兵馬使李盡忠與牙將康君立、薛志勤、程懷信、李存璋等謀曰：「今天下大亂，朝廷號令不復行於四方，此乃英雄立功名富貴之秋也。

translations.literal: At the time bandits rose everywhere in Henan; Yun prefecture Shatuo military commissioner Li Jinzhong and commandery generals Kang Junli, Xue Zhiqin, Cheng Huaixin, Li Cunzhang, and others plotted, saying, "Now the realm is in great disorder and the court's commands no longer run in the four directions—this is the season for heroes to establish merit, fame, wealth, and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels were rising across Henan. Yunzhou Shatuo military commissioner Li Jinzhong and commandery generals Kang Junli, Xue Zhiqin, Cheng Huaixin, Li Cunzhang, and others plotted together, saying, "The empire is in chaos and the court's orders no longer reach the provinces. This is the season for heroes to win fame, fortune, and rank

sentences.zh: 吾屬雖各擁兵眾，然李振武功大官高，名聞天下，其子勇冠諸軍。

translations.literal: Though we each command troops, Li the Zhenwu merit-holder has great achievement and high office, his name is known throughout the realm, and his son's courage tops all the armies.
translations.idiomatic: We each command troops, but Li the Zhenwu merit-holder has great deeds and high rank, his name is known throughout the realm, and his son's courage tops every army

sentences.zh: 若輔以舉事，代北不足平也。」

translations.literal: If we support him in raising arms, the north of Dai will be nothing to pacify."
translations.idiomatic: If we back him in rebellion, the north of Dai will be ours for the taking"

sentences.zh: 眾以為然。

translations.literal: All thought it right.
translations.idiomatic: All agreed

sentences.zh: 君立，興唐人；

translations.literal: Junli was a man of Xingtang;
translations.idiomatic: Junli was from Xingtang;

sentences.zh: 存璋，雲州人；

translations.literal: Cunzhang was a man of Yun prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Cunzhang was from Yunzhou;

sentences.zh: 志勤，奉誠人也。

translations.literal: Zhiqin was a man of Fengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiqin was from Fengcheng

sentences.zh: 會大同防禦使段文楚兼水陸發運使，代北荐饑，漕運不繼。

translations.literal: It happened that Datong defense commissioner Duan Wenchu also held the land and water transport post; north of Dai suffered repeated famine and grain transport could not keep up.
translations.idiomatic: Datong defense commissioner Duan Wenchu also served as land and water transport commissioner. North of Dai suffered repeated famine, and grain shipments could not keep up

sentences.zh: 文楚頗減軍士衣米，又用法稍峻，軍士怨怒。

translations.literal: Wenchu considerably reduced the soldiers' clothing and grain rations and applied the law rather harshly; the troops were resentful and angry.
translations.idiomatic: Wenchu cut the soldiers' clothing and grain rations and enforced the law harshly, and the troops seethed with resentment

sentences.zh: 盡忠遣君立潛詣蔚州說克用起兵，除文楚而代之。

translations.literal: Jinzhong sent Junli secretly to Wei prefecture to persuade Keyong to raise troops, remove Wenchu, and replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Jinzhong sent Junli secretly to Weizhou to urge Keyong to rise, remove Wenchu, and take his place

sentences.zh: 克用曰：「吾父在振武，俟我稟之。」

translations.literal: Keyong said, "My father is at Zhenwu; wait until I report to him."
translations.idiomatic: Keyong said, "My father is at Zhenwu. I must consult him first"

sentences.zh: 君立曰：「今機事已洩，緩則生變，何暇千里稟命乎！」

translations.literal: Junli said, "The plot is already leaked; delay will breed change—what leisure is there to report a thousand li away!"
translations.idiomatic: Junli replied, "The plot is already out. Delay will bring disaster—there is no time to send word a thousand li away!"

sentences.zh: 於是盡忠夜帥牙兵攻牙城，執文楚及判官柳漢璋等繫獄，自知軍州事，遣召克用。

translations.literal: Thereupon Jinzhong by night led the commandery troops to attack the headquarters city, seized Wenchu and administrative aide Liu Hanzhang and others and imprisoned them, took charge of military and prefectural affairs himself, and sent to summon Keyong.
translations.idiomatic: That night Jinzhong led the commandery troops against headquarters, seized Wenchu and administrative aide Liu Hanzhang and others and threw them in prison, took charge of the garrison and prefecture himself, and sent for Keyong

sentences.zh: 克用帥其眾趣雲州，行收兵，二月，庚午，至城下，眾且萬人，屯於鬥雞台下。

translations.literal: Keyong led his host toward Yun prefecture, gathering troops as he marched; in the second month, on gengwu, he reached below the walls with a host of nearly ten thousand and encamped below Cockfight Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong marched on Yunzhou, gathering troops along the way. In the second month, on gengwu, he reached the walls with nearly ten thousand men and encamped below Cockfight Terrace

sentences.zh: 壬申，盡忠遣使送符印，請克用為防禦留後。

translations.literal: On renshen, Jinzhong sent envoys with seals and tallies, requesting Keyong as defense commissioner and acting regent.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Jinzhong sent the seals of office and asked Keyong to become acting defense commissioner

sentences.zh: 癸酉，盡忠械文楚等五人送鬥雞台下，克用令軍士玼食之，以騎踐其骸。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Jinzhong sent Wenchu and five others in cangues to below Cockfight Terrace; Keyong ordered the soldiers to devour them raw and had horsemen trample their remains.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Jinzhong sent Wenchu and four others in bonds to Cockfight Terrace. Keyong had the soldiers tear them apart and trample their remains under horses' hooves

sentences.zh: 甲戌，克用入府捨視事，令將士表求敕命；

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Keyong entered the government quarters to conduct affairs and ordered officers and soldiers to submit a petition requesting an imperial commission;
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Keyong entered the yamen to govern and had his officers petition for an imperial commission;

sentences.zh: 朝廷不許。

translations.literal: the court did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: the court refused

sentences.zh: 李國昌上言：「乞朝廷速除大同防禦使。

translations.literal: Li Guochang submitted: "I beg the court quickly to appoint a Datong defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guochang wrote, "I beg the court to appoint a Datong defense commissioner at once

sentences.zh: 若克用違命，臣請帥本道兵討之，終不愛一子以負國家。」

translations.literal: If Keyong disobeys orders, your servant asks to lead this circuit's troops to attack him and will in the end not spare one son to betray the state."
translations.idiomatic: If Keyong disobeys, I will lead this circuit's troops against him. I will not spare even my own son to betray the state"

sentences.zh: 朝廷方欲使國昌諭克用，會得其奏，乃以司農卿支詳為大同軍宣慰使，詔國昌語克用，令迎候如常儀，除克用官，必令稱愜。

translations.literal: The court had just wished Guochang to instruct Keyong; happening to receive this memorial, it appointed Minister of Finance Zhi Xiang as Datong Army pacification commissioner, ordered Guochang to speak to Keyong, have him received with the usual ceremony, appoint Keyong to office, and make sure he was satisfied.
translations.idiomatic: The court had meant to have Guochang reason with Keyong. On receiving this memorial, it appointed minister of finance Zhi Xiang Datong pacification commissioner, ordered Guochang to speak with Keyong, receive him with normal ceremony, grant him office, and satisfy his demands

sentences.zh: 又以太僕卿盧簡方為大同防禦使。

translations.literal: It also appointed Grand Stable Master Lu Jianfang Datong defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: It also appointed grand stable master Lu Jianfang Datong defense commissioner

sentences.zh: 貶楊知溫為郴州司馬。

translations.literal: Yang Zhiwen was demoted to prefectural aide of Chen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhiwen was demoted to prefectural aide at Chenzhou

sentences.zh: 曾元裕奏大破王仙芝於黃梅，殺五萬餘人，追斬仙芝，傳首，餘黨散去。

translations.literal: Zeng Yuanyu memorialized a great defeat of Wang Xianzhi at Huangmei, killing more than fifty thousand men, pursuing and beheading Xianzhi, sending his head, and the remaining faction scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Yuanyu reported a great victory over Wang Xianzhi at Huangmei, killing more than fifty thousand rebels, pursuing and beheading Xianzhi and sending his head, after which the remnant bands scattered

sentences.zh: 黃巢方攻亳州未下，尚讓帥仙芝餘眾歸之，推巢為王，號沖天大將軍，改元王霸，署官屬。

translations.literal: Huang Chao was just attacking Bo prefecture without taking it; Shang Rang led Xianzhi's remnant host to join him, made Chao king with the title Great General Who Charges Heaven, changed the era name to Wangba, and appointed officials.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao was still besieging Bozhou when Shang Rang brought Xianzhi's remnant forces to him. They made Chao king under the title Great General Who Charges Heaven, proclaimed the era Wangba, and appointed a full staff of officials

sentences.zh: 巢襲陷沂州、濮州。

translations.literal: Chao raided and captured Yi and Pu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Chao raided and captured Yizhou and Puzhou

sentences.zh: 既而屢為官軍所敗，乃遺天平節度使張裼書，請奏之。

translations.literal: Soon after he was repeatedly defeated by government troops and then sent a letter to Tianping military governor Zhang Ti asking that it be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated defeats by government troops, he wrote Tianping military governor Zhang Ti asking that his offer be reported to the throne

sentences.zh: 詔以巢為右衛將軍，令就鄆州解甲。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Chao Right Guard general and ordered him to go to Yan prefecture and lay down arms.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Chao Right Guard general and ordered him to Yanzhou to disarm

sentences.zh: 巢竟不至。

translations.literal: Chao in the end did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Chao never came

sentences.zh: 加山南東道節度使李福同平章事，賞救荊南之功也。

translations.literal: Shannan East Circuit military governor Li Fu was given the additional title of co-director of the Secretariat, rewarding his merit in rescuing Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Shannan East military governor Li Fu was made co-director of the Secretariat in reward for saving Jingnan

sentences.zh: 三月，群盜陷朗州、岳州。

translations.literal: In the third month, the mass of bandits captured Lang and Yue prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, rebel bands took Langzhou and Yuezhou

sentences.zh: 招討使曾元裕屯荊、襄，黃巢自濮州掠宋、汴，乃以副使張自勉充東南面行營招討使。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Zeng Yuanyu was stationed at Jing and Xiang; Huang Chao from Pu prefecture plundered Song and Bian, and thereupon vice-commissioner Zhang Zimian was made southeast campaign pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Zeng Yuanyu held Jing and Xiang while Huang Chao marched from Puzhou to plunder Song and Bian. Vice-commissioner Zhang Zimian was then made southeast campaign pacification commissioner

sentences.zh: 黃巢攻衛南，遂攻葉、陽翟。

translations.literal: Huang Chao attacked Weinan and then attacked Ye and Yangdi.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao attacked Weinan, then Ye and Yangdi

sentences.zh: 詔發河陽兵千人赴東都，與宣武、昭義兵二千人共衛宮闕。

translations.literal: An edict mobilized a thousand Heyang troops to the Eastern Capital, and with two thousand Xuanwu and Zhaoyi troops together guarded the palace precincts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent a thousand Heyang troops to the Eastern Capital, together with two thousand from Xuanwu and Zhaoyi, to guard the palace

sentences.zh: 以左神武大將軍劉景仁充東都應援防遏使，並將三鎮兵，仍聽於東都募兵二千人。

translations.literal: Left Divine Martial grand general Liu Jingren was made Eastern Capital relief and defense commissioner, commanding the three circuits' troops and also permitted to recruit two thousand soldiers at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Left Divine Martial grand general Liu Jingren was made Eastern Capital relief commissioner, given command of the three circuits' troops, and allowed to recruit two thousand men in the capital

sentences.zh: 景仁，昌之孫也。

translations.literal: Jingren was a grandson of Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Jingren was a grandson of Liu Chang

sentences.zh: 又詔曾元裕將兵徑還東都，發義成兵三千守轘轅、伊闕、河陰、武牢。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered Zeng Yuanyu to lead troops straight back to the Eastern Capital and mobilized three thousand Yicheng troops to guard Huan-Yuan, Yique, Heyin, and Wulao.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered Zeng Yuanyu to march straight back to the Eastern Capital and sent three thousand Yicheng troops to hold Huan-Yuan, Yique, Heyin, and Wulao

sentences.zh: 王仙芝餘黨王重隱陷洪州，江西觀察使高湘奔湖口。

translations.literal: Wang Xianzhi's remnant follower Wang Chongyin captured Hong prefecture; Jiangxi observation commissioner Gao Xiang fled to Hukou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xianzhi's remnant Wang Chongyin took Hongzhou; Jiangxi observation commissioner Gao Xiang fled to Hukou

sentences.zh: 賊轉掠湖南，別將曹師雄掠宣、潤。

translations.literal: The bandits turned to plunder Hunan; a separate commander Cao Shixiong plundered Xuan and Run.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels turned to plunder Hunan while another commander, Cao Shixiong, ravaged Xuan and Run

sentences.zh: 詔曾元裕、楊復光引兵救宣、潤。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zeng Yuanyu and Yang Fuguang to lead troops to relieve Xuan and Run.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zeng Yuanyu and Yang Fuguang to march to the relief of Xuan and Run

sentences.zh: 湖南軍亂，都將高傑逐觀察使崔瑾。

translations.literal: The Hunan army mutinied; commandery general Gao Jie expelled observation commissioner Cui Jin.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan garrison mutinied; commandery general Gao Jie drove out observation commissioner Cui Jin

sentences.zh: 瑾，郾之子也。

translations.literal: Jin was a son of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Jin was a son of Cui Yan

sentences.zh: 黃巢引兵度江，攻陷虔、吉、饒、信等州。

translations.literal: Huang Chao led troops across the river and captured Qian, Ji, Rao, Xin, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao crossed the Yangzi and took Qian, Ji, Rao, Xin, and other prefectures

sentences.zh: 朝廷以李克用據雲中，夏，四月，以前大同軍防禦使盧簡方為振武節度使，以振武節度使李國昌為大同節度使，以為克用必無以拒也。

translations.literal: Because the court saw Li Keyong holding Yunzhong, in summer, the fourth month, former Datong Army defense commissioner Lu Jianfang was made Zhenwu military governor and Zhenwu military governor Li Guochang was made Datong military governor, thinking Keyong would have no way to refuse.
translations.idiomatic: With Li Keyong holding Yunzhong, in summer, the fourth month, the court made former Datong defense commissioner Lu Jianfang Zhenwu military governor and Zhenwu military governor Li Guochang Datong military governor, expecting Keyong could not refuse

sentences.zh: 詔以東都軍儲不足，貸商旅富人錢穀以供數月之費，仍賜空名殿中侍御史告身五通，監察御史告身十通，有能出家財助國稍多者賜之。

translations.literal: An edict, because Eastern Capital military stores were insufficient, loaned money and grain from traveling merchants and the wealthy to supply several months' expenses, and also granted five blank commissions as Attending Palace Censor and ten as Investigating Censor to be bestowed on those who could contribute family wealth to aid the state in somewhat larger amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Because Eastern Capital military stores were low, an edict borrowed money and grain from merchants and the wealthy for several months' expenses and offered blank commissions as attending palace censor (five) and investigating censor (ten) to those who contributed generously from private wealth

sentences.zh: 時連歲旱、蝗，寇盜充斥，耕桑半廢，租賦不足，內藏虛竭，無所人次助。

translations.literal: At the time drought and locusts continued year after year, bandits and robbers filled the land, farming and sericulture were half abandoned, tax and tribute were insufficient, the inner treasury was drained empty, and there was no revenue to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Years of drought and locusts, rebels everywhere, farming half abandoned, taxes falling short, and the inner treasury empty left the court with nowhere to turn for funds

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎、判度支楊嚴三表自陳才短，不能濟辦，乞解使務，辭極哀切。

translations.literal: Minister of War and acting director of the Treasury Yang Yan three times memorialized confessing his talents were short, that he could not manage affairs, begged to be relieved of commission duties, and his language was extremely plaintive.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of war and acting treasury director Yang Yan submitted three memorials confessing his inadequacy, begging to be relieved of fiscal duties, in language of desperate humility

sentences.zh: 詔不許。

translations.literal: An edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The court refused

sentences.zh: 曹師雄寇湖州，鎮海節度使裴璩遣兵擊破之。

translations.literal: Cao Shixiong raided Hu prefecture; Zhenhai military governor Pei Yu sent troops and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Shixiong raided Huzhou; Zhenhai military governor Pei Yu sent troops and defeated him

sentences.zh: 王重隱死，其將徐唐莒據洪州。

translations.literal: Wang Chongyin died; his general Xu Tangju held Hong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chongyin died; his general Xu Tangju held Hongzhou

sentences.zh: 饒州將彭幼璋合義營兵克復饒州。

translations.literal: Rao prefecture general Peng Youzhang combined righteous-camp troops and recovered Rao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Rao prefecture general Peng Youzhang joined local militia and recovered Raozhou

sentences.zh: 南詔遣其酋望趙宗政來請和親，無表，但令督爽牒中書，請為弟而不稱臣。

translations.literal: Nanzhao sent its chief minister Zhao Zongzheng to request a marriage alliance; there was no memorial, but he only had the supervising clerk notify the Secretariat, asking to be treated as younger brother and not styled subject.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhao sent chief minister Zhao Zongzheng to request a marriage alliance without a formal memorial, only a clerk's notice to the Secretariat asking to be treated as younger brother rather than subject

sentences.zh: 詔百官議之，禮部侍郎崔澹等以為：「南詔驕僭無禮，高駢不達大體，反因一僧呫囁卑辭誘致其使，若從其請，恐垂笑後代。」

translations.literal: An edict ordered the hundred officials to deliberate; Vice Minister of Rites Cui Tan and others held: "Nanzhao is arrogant and presumptuous without propriety; Gao Pian did not grasp the larger principle but instead, through one monk's whispered humble words, induced their envoy—if we follow their request, we fear posterity will laugh."
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered deliberation. Vice minister of rites Cui Tan and others argued that Nanzhao was arrogant and insolent, that Gao Pian had lost sight of larger interests by letting a monk's wheedling bring the envoy, and that yielding would make the dynasty a laughingstock for generations

sentences.zh: 高駢聞之，上表與澹爭辯，詔諭解之。

translations.literal: When Gao Pian heard of this, he submitted a memorial debating with Tan; an edict soothed and reconciled them.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Pian heard and memorialized in rebuttal; an edict soothed the dispute

sentences.zh: 澹，璵之子也。

translations.literal: Tan was a son of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Tan was a son of Cui Yu

sentences.zh: 五月，丙申朔，鄭畋、盧攜議蠻事，攜欲與之和親，畋固爭以為不可。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingshen new moon, Zheng Tian and Lu Xie debated the barbarian affair; Xie wished to make a marriage alliance with them, and Tian firmly argued that it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingshen new moon, Zheng Tian and Lu Xie debated the Nanzhao question. Xie favored a marriage alliance; Tian argued fiercely against it

sentences.zh: 攜怒，拂衣起，袂罥硯墮地，破之。

translations.literal: Xie grew angry, brushed his robe and rose; his sleeve caught the inkstone, which fell to the ground and broke.
translations.idiomatic: Xie flew into a rage, swept his robe aside and stood; his sleeve snagged the inkstone, which fell and shattered on the floor

sentences.zh: 上聞之，曰：「大臣相詬，何以儀刑四海！」

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it, he said: "Grand councillors reviling each other—how can this serve as a model for the four seas!"
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it, he said, "Grand councillors hurling abuse at each other—how can this stand as an example for the empire?

sentences.zh: 丁酉，畋、攜皆罷為主子賓客、分司。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Tian and Xie were both dismissed and made Crown Prince's Advisers with separate offices.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Tian and Xie were both removed from office and appointed Crown Prince's advisers with separate commissions

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎豆盧瑑為兵部侍郎，吏部侍郎崔沆為戶部侍郎，並同平章事。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance and Vice Minister of Revenue Dou Lu Zhuan was made Vice Minister of War, and Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Hang was made Vice Minister of Revenue; both were appointed Grand Councillors.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Lu Zhuan, Hanlin academician-in-attendance and vice minister of revenue, was appointed vice minister of war; Cui Hang, vice minister of personnel, was appointed vice minister of revenue; both became grand councillors

sentences.zh: 時宰相有好施者，常使人以布囊貯錢自隨，行施丐者，每出，襤褸盈路。

translations.literal: At the time one grand councillor was fond of giving alms; he often had men carry cloth bags filled with cash wherever he went, dispensing charity to beggars, and whenever he went out, ragged folk filled the road.
translations.idiomatic: One grand councillor at the time was fond of charity. He kept men carrying cloth sacks of cash wherever he went, handing coins to beggars; each time he went out, the ragged poor lined the streets

sentences.zh: 有朝士以書規之曰：「今百姓疲弊，寇盜充斥，相公宜舉賢任能，紀綱庶務，捐不急之費，杜私謁之門，使萬物各得其所，則家給人足，自無貧者，何必如此行小惠乎！」

translations.literal: A court official admonished him in a letter, saying: "The common people are now exhausted, and bandits and robbers are everywhere. Your Excellency ought to raise the worthy and employ the capable, put the myriad affairs in good order, cut unnecessary expenses, and shut the door to private petitions, so that all things find their proper place—then households will be supplied and the people content, and there will naturally be no poor. Why must you dispense petty favors in this way!"
translations.idiomatic: A court official wrote to remonstrate with him: "The people are exhausted and bandits roam everywhere. Your Excellency should promote the worthy, employ the capable, restore order to public affairs, cut needless spending, and close the door to private favor-seeking. Let every man find his place, and households will prosper—there will be no poor. Why dispense petty handouts like this?

sentences.zh: 宰相大怒。

translations.literal: The grand councillor was greatly angered.
translations.idiomatic: The grand councillor was furious

sentences.zh: 邕州大將杜弘送段瑳寶至南詔，逾年而還。

translations.literal: Yong prefecture general Du Hong escorted Duan Chen's tribute to Nanzhao and returned after more than a year.
translations.idiomatic: Du Hong, a senior officer of Yongzhou, escorted Duan Chen's tribute mission to Nanzhao and returned after more than a year

sentences.zh: 甲辰，辛讜復遣攝巡官賈宏、大將左瑜、曹朗使於南詔。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Xin Dang again sent acting inspector Jia Hong and generals Zuo Yu and Cao Lang as envoys to Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Xin Dang again dispatched acting inspector Jia Hong and generals Zuo Yu and Cao Lang as envoys to Nanzhao

sentences.zh: 李國昌欲父子並據兩鎮，得大同制書，毀之，殺監軍，不受代，與李克用合兵陷遮虜軍，進擊寧武及岢嵐軍。

translations.literal: Li Guochang wished for father and son jointly to hold two circuits; receiving the Datong appointment order, he destroyed it, killed the army supervisor, refused replacement, and joined forces with Li Keyong to take Zhelu Army, then advanced to attack Ningwu and Kelan armies.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guochang wanted father and son to hold two circuits between them. When he received the Datong appointment, he tore up the order, killed the army supervisor, and refused to be replaced. He joined Li Keyong, seized Zhelu Army, and advanced against Ningwu and Kelan

sentences.zh: 盧簡方赴振武，至嵐州而薨。

translations.literal: Lu Jianfang set out for Zhenwu and died at Lan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jianfang set out for Zhenwu and died en route at Lanzhou

sentences.zh: 丁巳，河東節度使竇浣發民塹晉陽。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Hedong military governor Dou Huan mobilized the people to dig trenches around Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Hedong military governor Dou Huan conscripted civilians to dig trenches around Jinyang

sentences.zh: 己未，以都押衙康傳圭為代州刺史，又發土團千人戍代州。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Chief Commandant Kang Chuangui was made prefect of Dai prefecture, and another thousand local militiamen were sent to garrison Dai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, chief commandant Kang Chuangu was appointed prefect of Daizhou, and another thousand local militiamen were sent to garrison the prefecture

sentences.zh: 土團至城北，娖隊不發，求優賞。

translations.literal: When the local militia reached the north of the city, they drew up in ranks but would not march, demanding extra rewards.
translations.idiomatic: When the militia reached the north gate, they formed ranks but refused to march, demanding extra pay

sentences.zh: 時府庫空竭，浣遣馬步都虞候鄧虔往慰諭之，土團□虔，床舁其屍入府。

translations.literal: The treasury was then empty; Huan sent infantry and cavalry chief adjutant Deng Qian to soothe and instruct them, but the local militia killed Qian and carried his corpse into the prefectural office on a litter.
translations.idiomatic: The treasury was empty. Huan sent infantry and cavalry chief adjutant Deng Qian to reason with them, but the militia killed Qian and carried his body into the prefectural office on a litter

sentences.zh: 浣與監軍自出慰諭，人給錢三百，布一端，眾乃定。

translations.literal: Huan and the army supervisor went out in person to soothe and instruct them; each man was given three hundred cash and one bolt of cloth, and the crowd then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Huan and the army supervisor went out in person to calm them, giving each man three hundred cash and one bolt of cloth; the crowd then settled

sentences.zh: 押牙田公鍔給亂軍錢布，從遂劫之以為都將，赴代州，浣借商人錢五萬緡以助軍。

translations.literal: Adjutant Tian Gong'e gave money and cloth to the mutinous troops, but they then seized him and made him their commander, and marched to Dai prefecture; Huan borrowed fifty thousand strings of cash from merchants to support the army.
translations.idiomatic: Adjutant Tian Gong'e paid the mutineers money and cloth, but they seized him and made him their commander, then marched on Daizhou. Huan borrowed fifty thousand strings of cash from merchants to fund the army

sentences.zh: 朝廷以浣為不才，六月，以前昭義節度使曹翔為河東節度使。

translations.literal: The court considered Huan incompetent; in the sixth month, former Zhaoyi military governor Cao Xiang was made Hedong military governor.
translations.idiomatic: The court judged Huan incompetent. In the sixth month, former Zhaoyi military governor Cao Xiang was appointed Hedong military governor

sentences.zh: 王仙芝餘黨剽掠浙西，朝廷以荊南節度使高駢先在天平有威名，仙芝黨多鄆人，乃徙駢為鎮海節度使。

translations.literal: Remnants of Wang Xianzhi's band plundered western Zhe; the court, because Jingnan military governor Gao Pian had earlier had a formidable reputation at Tianping and many of Xianzhi's followers were men of Yan, transferred Pian to be Zhenhai military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Remnants of Wang Xianzhi's rebels plundered western Zhejiang. Because Gao Pian had won fame at Tianping and many of Xianzhi's followers were men of Yan, the court transferred Pian to be Zhenhai military governor

sentences.zh: 沙陀焚唐林、崞縣，入忻州境。

translations.literal: The Shatuo burned Tanglin and Guo counties and entered the territory of Xin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shatuo burned Tanglin and Guo counties and crossed into Xinzhou territory

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，曹翔至晉陽。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Cao Xiang reached Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Cao Xiang arrived at Jinyang

sentences.zh: 己亥，捕土團殺鄧虔者十三人，殺之。

translations.literal: On jihai, thirteen local militiamen who had killed Deng Qian were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, thirteen militiamen who had killed Deng Qian were captured and executed

sentences.zh: 義武兵至晉陽，不解甲，歡噪求優賞，翔斬其十將一人，乃定。

translations.literal: Yiwu troops reached Jinyang, would not doff their armor, and clamored noisily for extra rewards; Xiang beheaded one of their ten commanders, and only then were they settled.
translations.idiomatic: When Yiwu troops reached Jinyang, they kept their armor on and clamored for extra pay. Xiang beheaded one of their ten commanders, and order was restored

sentences.zh: 發義成、忠武、昭義、河陽兵會於晉陽，以御沙陀。

translations.literal: Troops of Yicheng, Zhongwu, Zhaoyi, and Heyang were mobilized to assemble at Jinyang to resist the Shatuo.
translations.idiomatic: Troops from Yicheng, Zhongwu, Zhaoyi, and Heyang were assembled at Jinyang to resist the Shatuo

sentences.zh: 八月，戊寅，曹翔引兵救忻州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuyin, Cao Xiang led troops to relieve Xin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuyin, Cao Xiang led troops to relieve Xinzhou

sentences.zh: 沙陀攻岢嵐軍，陷其羅城，敗官軍於洪谷，晉陽閉門城守。

translations.literal: The Shatuo attacked Kelan Army, took its outer wall, defeated the government army at Honggu, and Jinyang closed its gates and defended the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Shatuo attacked Kelan Army, breached its outer wall, and routed the government forces at Honggu. Jinyang shut its gates and held the city

sentences.zh: 黃巢寇宣州，宣歙觀察使王凝拒之，敗於南陵。

translations.literal: Huang Chao raided Xuan prefecture; Xuanshe observation commissioner Wang Ning resisted him and was defeated at Nanling.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao raided Xuanzhou. Xuanshe observation commissioner Wang Ning resisted but was defeated at Nanling

sentences.zh: 巢攻宣州不克，乃引兵入浙東，開山路七百里，攻剽福建諸州。

translations.literal: Chao failed to take Xuan prefecture, then led his troops into eastern Zhe, opened a mountain road seven hundred li long, and raided the prefectures of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Chao failed to take Xuanzhou, then marched into eastern Zhejiang, cut a mountain road seven hundred li long, and raided the prefectures of Fujian

sentences.zh: 九月，平盧軍奏節度使宋威薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Pinglu army reported that military governor Song Wei had died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Pinglu army reported that military governor Song Wei had died

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以諸道行營招討使曾元裕領平盧節度使。

translations.literal: On xinchou, campaign pacification commissioner of all circuits Zeng Yuanyu was appointed to head Pinglu as military governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zeng Yuanyu, pacification commissioner of all circuits, was appointed military governor of Pinglu

sentences.zh: 壬寅，曹翔暴薨。

translations.literal: On renyin, Cao Xiang died suddenly.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Cao Xiang died suddenly

sentences.zh: 丙午，昭義兵大掠晉陽，坊市民自共擊之，殺千餘人，乃潰。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Zhaoyi troops plundered Jinyang on a great scale; ward residents jointly attacked them, killed more than a thousand men, and they then broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhaoyi troops looted Jinyang on a large scale. Townspeople banded together to attack them, killed more than a thousand, and the raiders broke and fled

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎、同平章事李蔚罷為東都留守。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor Li Wei was dismissed and made eastern capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wei, vice director of the Secretariat and grand councillor, was removed and made regent of the eastern capital

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書鄭從讜為中書侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Zheng Congdang was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Congdang, minister of personnel, was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and grand councillor

sentences.zh: 從讜，餘慶之孫也。

translations.literal: Congdang was a grandson of Yuqing.
translations.idiomatic: Congdang was a grandson of Zheng Yuqing

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書、判戶部事李都同平章事兼河中節度使。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue and acting head of the Revenue Bureau Li Du was made Grand Councillor and concurrently Hedong military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Du, minister of revenue and acting head of the Revenue Bureau, was appointed grand councillor and concurrently Hedong military governor

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，詔昭義節度使李鈞、幽州節度使李可舉與吐谷渾酋長赫連鐸、白義誠、沙陀酋長安慶、薩葛酋長米海萬，合兵討李國昌父子於蔚州。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, an edict ordered Zhaoyi military governor Li Jun, Youzhou military governor Li Keju, Tuyuhun chieftains Helian Duo and Bai Yicheng, Shatuo chieftain An Qing, and Sagye chieftain Mi Haiwan jointly to campaign against Li Guochang and his son at Wei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, an edict ordered Zhaoyi military governor Li Jun, Youzhou military governor Li Keju, Tuyuhun chieftains Helian Duo and Bai Yicheng, Shatuo chieftain An Qing, and Sagye chieftain Mi Haiwan to combine forces and attack Li Guochang and his son at Weizhou

sentences.zh: 十一月，甲午，岢嵐軍翻城應沙陀。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiawu, Kelan Army turned the city over in response to the Shatuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiawu, Kelan Army opened the city gates to the Shatuo

sentences.zh: 丁未，以河東宣慰使崔季康為河東節度、代北行營招討使。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Hedong consolation commissioner Cui Jikang was made Hedong military governor and pacification commissioner of the northern Dai campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Cui Jikang, Hedong consolation commissioner, was appointed military governor of Hedong and pacification commissioner of the northern Dai campaign

sentences.zh: 沙陀攻石州，庚戌，崔季康救之。

translations.literal: The Shatuo attacked Shi prefecture; on gengxu, Cui Jikang went to its relief.
translations.idiomatic: The Shatuo attacked Shizhou. On gengxu, Cui Jikang marched to relieve it

sentences.zh: 十二月，甲戌，黃巢陷福州，觀察使韋岫棄城走。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, Huang Chao took Fuzhou; observation commissioner Wei Xiu abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, Huang Chao took Fuzhou. Observation commissioner Wei Xiu abandoned the city and fled

sentences.zh: 南詔使者趙宗政還其國，中書不答督爽牒，但作西川節度使崔安潛書意，使安潛答之。

translations.literal: The Nanzhao envoy Zhao Zongzheng returned to his country; the Secretariat did not reply to the supervising clerk's notification but drafted the sense of a letter from Xichuan military governor Cui Anqian and had Anqian answer.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhao envoy Zhao Zongzheng returned home. The Secretariat did not answer the clerk's notification directly but drafted a reply in the name of Xichuan military governor Cui Anqian and had Anqian send it

sentences.zh: 崔季康及昭義節度使李鈞與李克用戰於洪谷，兩鎮兵敗，鈞戰死。

translations.literal: Cui Jikang and Zhaoyi military governor Li Jun fought Li Keyong at Honggu; the troops of both circuits were defeated, and Jun died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Jikang and Zhaoyi military governor Li Jun fought Li Keyong at Honggu. Both armies were defeated and Jun was killed in battle

sentences.zh: 昭義兵還至代州，士卒剽掠，代州民殺之殆盡，餘眾自鴉鳴谷走歸上黨。

translations.literal: When Zhaoyi troops returned to Dai prefecture, the soldiers plundered; the people of Dai prefecture killed nearly all of them, and the survivors fled back to Shangdang through Yamming Valley.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaoyi troops returned to Daizhou, the soldiers looted the countryside. The people of Daizhou killed nearly all of them; the survivors fled back to Shangdang through Yamming Valley

sentences.zh: 王郢之亂，臨安人董昌以土團討賊有功，補石鏡鎮將。

translations.literal: In Wang Ying's rebellion, Lin'an man Dong Chang, having merit in suppressing bandits with local militia, was appointed garrison commander of Shijing.
translations.idiomatic: During Wang Ying's rebellion, Dong Chang of Lin'an, who had distinguished himself suppressing bandits with local militia, was appointed garrison commander of Shijing

sentences.zh: 是歲，曹師雄寇二浙，杭州募諸縣鄉兵各千人以討之，昌與錢塘劉孟安、阮結、富陽聞人宇、鹽官徐及、新城杜稜、餘杭凌文舉、臨平曹信各為之都將，號杭州八都，昌為之長。

translations.literal: That year, when Cao Shixiong raided the two Zhes, Hang prefecture recruited a thousand village militiamen from each county to attack him; Chang, together with Liu Meng'an, Ruan Jie of Qiantang, Wenren Yu of Fuyang, Xu Ji of Yanguan, Du Ling of Xincheng, Ling Wenju of Yuhang, and Cao Xin of Linping, each served as commander, forming the Eight Commands of Hang prefecture, with Chang as their head.
translations.idiomatic: That year Cao Shixiong raided the two Zhes. Hangzhou recruited a thousand village militiamen from each county to fight him. Chang, together with Liu Meng'an and Ruan Jie of Qiantang, Wenren Yu of Fuyang, Xu Ji of Yanguan, Du Ling of Xincheng, Ling Wenju of Yuhang, and Cao Xin of Linping, each commanded a unit. They were called the Eight Commands of Hangzhou, with Chang as their leader

sentences.zh: 其後宇卒，錢塘人成及代之。

translations.literal: Later Yu died, and Cheng Ji of Qiantang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Later Yu died and was replaced by Cheng Ji of Qiantang

sentences.zh: 臨安人錢鏐以驍勇事昌，以功為石鏡都知兵馬使。

translations.literal: Qian Liu of Lin'an, valiant and brave, served Chang; for his merit he was made Shijing director of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu of Lin'an, fierce and brave, served under Chang and, for his achievements, was made Shijing director of military affairs

sentences.zh: 僖宗聖恭定孝皇帝上之下乾符六年（己亥，公元八七九年） 。

translations.literal: Emperor Xizong the Sagely, Respectful, Settled, and Filial—lower part of the Upper Annals—Qianfu year 6 (jihai, 879 CE).
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xizong the Sagely, Respectful, Settled, and Filial—lower portion of the Upper Annals—Qianfu year 6 (jihai, 879 CE)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，魏王佾薨。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, Prince of Wei Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, Prince of Wei Yi died

sentences.zh: 鎮海節度使高駢遣其將張璘、梁纘分道擊黃巢，屢破之，降其將秦彥、畢師鐸、李罕之、許勍等數十人，巢遂趣廣南。

translations.literal: Zhenhai military governor Gao Pian sent his generals Zhang Lin and Liang Zuan by separate routes to attack Huang Chao, repeatedly defeated him, and accepted the surrender of his generals Qin Yan, Bi Shiduo, Li Hanzhi, Xu Qing, and several dozen others; Chao then hastened toward Guangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenhai military governor Gao Pian sent generals Zhang Lin and Liang Zuan by separate routes against Huang Chao, repeatedly defeated him, and accepted the surrender of his generals Qin Yan, Bi Shiduo, Li Hanzhi, Xu Qing, and dozens of others. Chao then fled toward Guangnan

sentences.zh: 彥，徐州人；

translations.literal: Yan was a man of Xuzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Yan was from Xuzhou;

sentences.zh: 師鐸，冤句人；

translations.literal: Shiduo was a man of Yuanqu;
translations.idiomatic: Shiduo was from Yuanqu;

sentences.zh: 罕之，項城人也。

translations.literal: Hanzhi was a man of Xiangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Hanzhi was from Xiangcheng.

sentences.zh: 賈寵等未至南詔，相繼卒於道中，從者死亦太半。

translations.literal: Jia Chong and the others had not yet reached Nanzhao when they died one after another on the road; of their followers, more than half also died.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Chong and the others never reached Nanzhao—they died one after another on the road, and more than half their followers died as well

sentences.zh: 時辛讜已病風痺，召攝巡官徐雲虔，執其手曰：「讜已奏朝廷發使入南詔，而使者相繼物故，奈何？

translations.literal: At the time Xin Dang was already ill with wind paralysis; he summoned acting inspector Xu Yunqian, took his hand, and said: "Dang has already memorialized the court to send envoys into Nanzhao, yet the envoys have died one after another—what is to be done?
translations.idiomatic: Xin Dang was already stricken with paralysis. He summoned acting inspector Xu Yunqian, took his hand, and said, "I have memorialized the court to send envoys to Nanzhao, yet they keep dying on the road. What can be done?

sentences.zh: 吾子既仕則思詢國，能為此行乎？

translations.literal: You, having entered office, ought to think of serving the state—can you make this journey?
translations.idiomatic: You hold office and ought to serve the state. Can you make this journey?

sentences.zh: 讜恨風痺不能拜耳。」

translations.literal: Dang regrets that the paralysis keeps him from bowing."
translations.idiomatic: Dang lamented that paralysis kept him from bowing

sentences.zh: 因嗚咽流涕。

translations.literal: He then sobbed and shed tears.
translations.idiomatic: He broke down in tears

sentences.zh: 雲虔曰：「士為知己死！

translations.literal: Yunqian said: "A gentleman dies for one who knows him!
translations.idiomatic: Yunqian said, "A gentleman dies for one who knows him!

sentences.zh: 明公見辟，恨無以報德，敢不承命！」

translations.literal: Your Lordship took me in; I regret having no way to repay your kindness—how could I refuse the commission!"
translations.idiomatic: You took me in, and I have no way to repay your kindness. How could I refuse?

sentences.zh: 讜喜，厚具資裝而遣之。

translations.literal: Dang was pleased, amply furnished traveling expenses, and sent him off.
translations.idiomatic: Dang was overjoyed, furnished him generously for the journey, and sent him off

sentences.zh: 二月，丙寅，雲虔至善闡城，驃信見大使抗禮，受副使以下拜。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingyin, Yunqian reached Shanchan city; Piluoge received the chief envoy with equal ceremony and had the deputy envoy and those below bow.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingyin, Yunqian reached Shanchan. Piluoge received the chief envoy as an equal and had the deputy and those below bow

sentences.zh: 己巳，驃信使慈雙羽、楊宗就館謂雲虔曰：「貴府牒欲使驃信稱臣，奉表貢方物；

translations.literal: On jisi, Piluoge sent Ci Shuangyu and Yang Zong to the guest lodge to tell Yunqian: "Your office's notification wishes Piluoge to style himself subject, submit a memorial, and offer tribute goods;
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Piluoge sent Ci Shuangyu and Yang Zong to the guest quarters to tell Yunqian, "Your office's notice asks Piluoge to style himself subject, submit a memorial, and offer tribute goods;

sentences.zh: 驃信已遣人自西川入唐，與唐約為兄弟，不則舅甥。

translations.literal: Piluoge has already sent men from Xichuan into Tang to arrange with Tang to be brothers, or else maternal uncle and nephew.
translations.idiomatic: Piluoge has already sent men from Xichuan to arrange with Tang to be brothers, or else uncle and nephew

sentences.zh: 夫兄弟舅甥，書幣而已，何表貢之有？」

translations.literal: Between brothers or maternal uncle and nephew, letters and gifts suffice—what need is there for memorials and tribute?"
translations.idiomatic: Between brothers or uncle and nephew, letters and gifts suffice. What need is there for memorials and tribute?

sentences.zh: 雲虔曰：「驃信既欲為弟、為甥，驃信景莊之子，景莊豈無兄弟，於驃信為諸父，驃信為君，則諸父皆稱臣，況弟與甥乎！

translations.literal: Yunqian said: "Since Piluoge wishes to be younger brother or nephew, Piluoge is the son of Jingzhuang; surely Jingzhuang had brothers, who to Piluoge are paternal uncles. If Piluoge is ruler, then the paternal uncles all style themselves subjects—how much more so younger brother and nephew!
translations.idiomatic: Yunqian replied, "If Piluoge wishes to be younger brother or nephew, consider this: Piluoge is the son of Jingzhuang. Jingzhuang surely had brothers—they are Piluoge's paternal uncles. If Piluoge is ruler, his uncles must style themselves subjects. How much more so a younger brother or nephew!

sentences.zh: 且驃信之先，由大唐之命，得合六詔為一，恩德深厚，中間小忿，罪在邊鄙。

translations.literal: Moreover, Piluoge's forebears, by Great Tang's command, were able to unite the six zhao into one; the grace and virtue were deep and thick, and the small resentment in between lay with the border officials.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Piluoge's forebears, by Tang's command, united the six zhao into one. The grace was profound; the small quarrel since lay with border officials

sentences.zh: 今驃信欲修舊好，豈可違祖考之故事乎！

translations.literal: Now Piluoge wishes to restore the old friendship—how can he violate the precedent of his ancestors!
translations.idiomatic: Now Piluoge wishes to restore the old friendship. How can he violate his ancestors' precedent?

sentences.zh: 順祖考，孝也；

translations.literal: Following one's ancestors is filial piety;
translations.idiomatic: Following one's ancestors is filial piety;

sentences.zh: 事大國，義也；

translations.literal: serving the great state is righteousness;
translations.idiomatic: serving the great state is righteousness;

sentences.zh: 息戰爭，仁也；

translations.literal: ending warfare is benevolence;
translations.idiomatic: ending warfare is benevolence;

sentences.zh: 審名分，禮也。

translations.literal: examining names and ranks is propriety.
translations.idiomatic: examining names and ranks is propriety.

sentences.zh: 四者，皆令德也，可不勉乎！」

translations.literal: These four are all fine virtues—should one not strive for them!"
translations.idiomatic: All four are fine virtues. Should one not strive for them?

sentences.zh: 驃信待雲虔甚厚，雲虔留善闡十七日而還。

translations.literal: Piluoge treated Yunqian very generously; Yunqian stayed at Shanchan seventeen days and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: Piluoge treated Yunqian with great generosity. Yunqian remained at Shanchan seventeen days, then returned

sentences.zh: 驃信以木夾二授雲虔，其一上中書門下，其一牒嶺南西道，然猶未肯奉表稱貢。

translations.literal: Piluoge gave Yunqian two wooden tablets: one addressed to the Secretariat and Chancellery, one notifying Lingnan West Circuit—but he still would not submit a memorial or styled tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Piluoge gave Yunqian two wooden tablets, one for the Secretariat and Chancellery and one for Lingnan West Circuit—but he still would not submit a memorial or styled tribute

sentences.zh: 辛未，河東軍至靜樂，士卒作亂，殺孔目官石裕等。

translations.literal: On xinwei, when the Hedong army reached Jingle, the soldiers mutinied and killed chief clerk Shi Yu and others.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, when the Hedong army reached Jingle, the soldiers mutinied and killed chief clerk Shi Yu and others

sentences.zh: 壬申，崔季康逃歸晉陽。

translations.literal: On renshen, Cui Jikang fled back to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Cui Jikang fled back to Jinyang

sentences.zh: 甲戌，都頭張鍇、郭昢帥行營兵攻東陽門，入府，殺季康。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, commanders Zhang Kai and Guo Fen led campaign headquarters troops to attack the Dongyang Gate, entered the prefectural office, and killed Jikang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, commanders Zhang Kai and Guo Fen led campaign troops against the Dongyang Gate, entered the prefectural office, and killed Jikang

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以陝虢觀察使高潯為昭義節度使；

translations.literal: On xinsi, Shaan-Guo observation commissioner Gao Xun was made Zhaoyi military governor;
