translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Gao Xun, observation commissioner of Shaan and Guo, became military governor of Zhaoyi;

sentences.zh: 以邠寧節度使李侃為河東節度使。

translations.literal: Binning military governor Li Kan was made Hedong military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Kan, military governor of Binning, became military governor of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 三月，天平軍節度使張裼薨，牙將崔君裕自知州事，淄州刺史曹全晸討誅之。

translations.literal: In the third month, Tianping army military governor Zhang Ti died; adjutant Cui Junyu himself assumed prefectural affairs; Zi prefecture prefect Cao Quanzhen attacked and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Tianping commander Zhang Ti died. His adjutant Cui Junyu seized the prefecture; Cao Quanzhen, prefect of Zi, marched in and executed him.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，庚申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the gengshen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month: on the gengshen new moon, the sun was eaten.

sentences.zh: 西川節度使崔安潛到官不詰盜，蜀人怪之。

translations.literal: When Xichuan military governor Cui Anqian took office he did not pursue robbers, and the people of Shu thought it strange.
translations.idiomatic: When Cui Anqian arrived in Sichuan as military governor, he did not hunt robbers. The people of Shu thought this odd.

sentences.zh: 安潛曰：「盜非所由通容則不能為。

translations.literal: Anqian said: "Robbers cannot act unless someone in office connives at and shelters them.
translations.idiomatic: Anqian said, "Robbers cannot work unless someone in office shelters them.

sentences.zh: 今窮核則應坐者眾，搜捕則徒為煩擾。」

translations.literal: If we investigate thoroughly now, many would be implicated; if we hunt them down, it would only create pointless turmoil."
translations.idiomatic: Dig deep and many must fall; hunt them down and you only stir useless trouble.

sentences.zh: 甲子，出庫錢千五百緡，分置三市，置榜其上曰：「有能告捕一盜，賞錢五百緡。

translations.literal: On jiazi, he disbursed fifteen hundred strings of cash from the treasury, placed them in three markets, and posted a placard saying: "Whoever can inform on and capture one robber will be rewarded five hundred strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he took fifteen hundred strings from the treasury, split the reward across three markets, and posted this: "Capture one robber—five hundred strings.

sentences.zh: 盜不能獨為，必有侶。

translations.literal: A robber cannot act alone; he must have accomplices.
translations.idiomatic: A robber cannot act alone; he must have accomplices

sentences.zh: 侶者告捕，釋其罪，賞同平人。」

translations.literal: If an accomplice informs and captures him, his crime is pardoned and he receives the same reward as an ordinary man."
translations.idiomatic: If an accomplice informs and captures him, his crime is pardoned and he receives the same reward as anyone else

sentences.zh: 未幾，有捕盜而至者，盜不服，曰：「汝與我同為盜十七年，贓皆平分，汝安能捕我！

translations.literal: Before long, one who had captured a robber was brought in; the robber would not submit, saying: "You and I were robbers together for seventeen years; the loot was always divided equally—how can you capture me!
translations.idiomatic: Soon a captor brought a robber before him. The robber refused to yield: "Seventeen years we robbed together and split every take. How dare you capture me!

sentences.zh: 我與汝同死耳。」

translations.literal: I will die with you—that is all."
translations.idiomatic: I will die with you—that is all

sentences.zh: 安潛曰：「汝既知吾有榜，何不捕彼以來！

translations.literal: Anqian said: "Since you knew I had the placard, why did you not capture him and bring him in!
translations.idiomatic: Anqian said, "You knew my notice—why not capture him and bring him in?

sentences.zh: 則彼應死，汝受賞矣。

translations.literal: Then he would deserve death and you would receive the reward.
translations.idiomatic: Then he would die and you would collect the reward

sentences.zh: 汝既為所失，死復何辭！」

translations.literal: You have already lost out—what excuse have you for dying!"
translations.idiomatic: You missed your chance. What excuse do you have for dying now?

sentences.zh: 立命給捕者錢，使盜視之，然後□盜於市，並滅其家。

translations.literal: He immediately ordered money given to the captor, had the robber watch, then executed the robber in the market and exterminated his household.
translations.idiomatic: He paid the captor at once, made the robber watch, then executed him in the market and wiped out his household.

sentences.zh: 於是諸盜與其侶互相疑，無地容足，夜不及旦，散逃出境，境內遂無一人為盜。

translations.literal: Thereupon all the robbers and their accomplices grew mutually suspicious, had nowhere to set foot, and before night gave way to dawn had scattered and fled beyond the borders; within the territory there was then not a single robber.
translations.idiomatic: Robbers and partners turned on one another. With nowhere to stand, they fled the region before dawn, and the land held not one thief.

sentences.zh: 安潛以蜀兵怯弱，奏遣大將繼牒詣陳、許諸州募壯士，與蜀人相雜，訓練用之，得三千人，分為三軍，亦戴黃帽，號黃頭軍。

translations.literal: Anqian, because Shu troops were timid and weak, memorialized to send General Ji Die to Chen, Xu, and other prefectures to recruit stalwart men, mix them with Shu men, train and employ them, obtaining three thousand men divided into three armies; they also wore yellow caps and were called the Yellow-cap Army.
translations.idiomatic: Shu soldiers were timid; Anqian sent General Ji Die to Chen, Xu, and neighboring prefectures to recruit hard men, mixed them with locals, and trained three thousand in three armies—all in yellow caps, the Yellow-cap Army.

sentences.zh: 又奏乞洪州弩手，教蜀人用弩走丸而射之，選得千人，號神機弩營。

translations.literal: He also memorialized requesting crossbowmen from Hong prefecture, taught Shu men to shoot bolts while running, selected a thousand men, and called them the Divine-engine Crossbow Camp.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested crossbowmen from Hongzhou, taught Shu soldiers to shoot while running, selected a thousand men, and formed the Divine-engine Crossbow Camp

sentences.zh: 蜀兵由是浸強。

translations.literal: Shu troops thereby gradually grew stronger.
translations.idiomatic: Shu troops gradually grew stronger

sentences.zh: 涼王侹薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Liang Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Liang Yan died

sentences.zh: 上以群盜為憂，王鐸曰：「臣為宰相之長，在朝不足分陛下之憂，請自督諸將討之。」

translations.literal: The emperor was troubled by the bandits; Wang Duo said: "Your servant, as chief among the grand councillors, in court is not enough to share Your Majesty's worries—I ask to supervise the generals myself in suppressing them."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor brooded over the bandits. Wang Duo said, "I am chief among your councillors, yet in court I cannot lighten your burden. Let me take the field and command the generals myself.

sentences.zh: 乃以鐸守司徒兼侍中，充荊南節度使、南面行營招討都統。

translations.literal: Wang Duo was then made Defender of the Ministry of Works and concurrently Palace Attendant, and appointed Jingnan military governor and overall commander of the southern campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Duo was made defender of the Ministry of Works and palace attendant, and appointed Jingnan military governor and overall commander of the southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 五月，辛卯，敕賜河東軍士銀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinmao, an edict granted silver to Hedong soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinmao, an edict granted silver to Hedong soldiers

sentences.zh: 牙將賀公雅所部士卒作亂，焚掠三城，執孔目官王敬送馬步司。

translations.literal: The troops under adjutant He Gongya mutinied, burned and plundered the three cities, seized chief clerk Wang Jing, and sent him to the infantry and cavalry office.
translations.idiomatic: Troops under adjutant He Gongya mutinied, burned and plundered the three cities, seized chief clerk Wang Jing, and sent him to the infantry and cavalry office

sentences.zh: 節度使李侃與監軍自由慰諭，為之斬敬於牙門，乃定。

translations.literal: Military governor Li Kan and the army supervisor went out in person to soothe and instruct them; for this they beheaded Jing at the headquarters gate, and order was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Military governor Li Kan and the army supervisor went out in person to calm them and beheaded Jing at headquarters gate; order was restored

sentences.zh: 泰寧節度使李系，晟之曾孫也，有口才而實無勇略，王鐸以其家世良將，奏為行營副將統兼湖南觀察使，使將精兵五萬並土團屯潭州，以塞嶺北之路，拒黃巢。

translations.literal: Taining military governor Li Xi was a great-grandson of Li Sheng; he had a gift for words but in fact no courage or strategy. Wang Duo, because his family for generations had been fine generals, memorialized to make him deputy overall commander of the campaign headquarters and concurrently Hunan observation commissioner, and had him lead fifty thousand picked troops together with local militia to garrison Tan prefecture, block the road north of the ranges, and resist Huang Chao.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xi of Taining was Li Sheng's great-grandson—silver-tongued, empty of courage. Duo, honoring a house of generals, made him deputy campaign commander and Hunan observation commissioner, with fifty thousand picked troops and militia to hold Tanzhou, seal the northern passes, and block Huang Chao.

sentences.zh: 河東都虞候每夜密捕賀公雅部卒作亂者，族滅之。

translations.literal: The Hedong chief adjutant each night secretly captured mutineers among He Gongya's troops and exterminated their clans.
translations.idiomatic: Each night the Hedong chief adjutant secretly captured mutineers among He Gongya's troops and exterminated their clans

sentences.zh: 丁巳，餘黨近百人稱「報冤將」，大掠三城，焚馬步都虞候張鍇、府城都虞候郭昢家。

translations.literal: On dingsi, nearly a hundred remaining partisans styled themselves the "Avengers," plundered the three cities on a great scale, and burned the homes of infantry and cavalry chief adjutant Zhang Kai and prefectural-city chief adjutant Guo Fen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi nearly a hundred survivors called themselves the "Avengers." They looted the three cities and burned the homes of Zhang Kai and Guo Fen.

sentences.zh: 節度使李侃下令，以軍府不安，曲順軍情，收鍇、昢，斬於牙門，並逐其家；

translations.literal: Military governor Li Kan issued an order that, because the army headquarters was unsettled, he would bend to the soldiers' mood; Kai and Fen were seized, beheaded at the headquarters gate, and their families expelled;
translations.idiomatic: Li Kan issued an order that, with headquarters unsettled, he would bend to the soldiers' mood. Kai and Fen were seized, beheaded at headquarters gate, and their families expelled;

sentences.zh: 以賀公雅為馬步都虞候。

translations.literal: He Gongya was made infantry and cavalry chief adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: He Gongya was made infantry and cavalry chief adjutant

sentences.zh: 鍇、昢臨刑，泣言於眾曰：「所殺皆捕盜司密申，今日冤死，獨無烈士相救乎！」

translations.literal: As Kai and Fen faced execution, they wept and said to the crowd: "Those killed were all secretly reported by the bandit-capture office—is there no brave man to save us from this wrongful death!"
translations.idiomatic: At the block, Kai and Fen wept to the troops: "Every man we killed was named in secret by the bandit office. Will no one save us from this unjust death?

sentences.zh: 於是軍士復大噪，篡取鍇、昢歸都虞候司。

translations.literal: Thereupon the soldiers again raised a great clamor, seized Kai and Fen, and returned them to the chief adjutant's office.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers raised a great clamor, seized Kai and Fen, and returned them to the chief adjutant's office

sentences.zh: 尋下令，復其舊職，並召還其家。

translations.literal: Soon an order was issued restoring them to their old posts and recalling their families.
translations.idiomatic: An order soon restored them to their old posts and recalled their families

sentences.zh: 收捕盜司元義宗等三十餘家，誅滅之。

translations.literal: More than thirty households of the bandit-capture office, including Yuan Yizong, were seized and exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: More than thirty households of the bandit-capture office, including Yuan Yizong, were seized and exterminated

sentences.zh: 己未，以馬步都教練使朱玫等為三城斬斫使，將兵分捕報冤將，悉斬之，軍城始定。

translations.literal: On jiwei, infantry and cavalry drill instructor Zhu Mei and others were made slash-and-cut commissioners of the three cities; they led troops separately to hunt the Avengers, beheaded them all, and the army city was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, drill instructor Zhu Mei and others were made slash-and-cut commissioners of the three cities. They led troops to hunt the Avengers, beheaded them all, and the army city was finally settled

sentences.zh: 黃巢與浙東觀察使崔璆、嶺南東道節度使李迢書，求天平節度使，二人為之奏聞，朝廷不許。

translations.literal: Huang Chao wrote to eastern Zhe observation commissioner Cui Qiu and Lingnan East Circuit military governor Li Tiao, requesting the Tianping military governorship; the two men memorialized this for the court, and the court did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao wrote to eastern Zhe observation commissioner Cui Qiu and Lingnan East Circuit military governor Li Tiao requesting the Tianping military governorship. Both memorialized the request; the court refused

sentences.zh: 巢復上表求廣州節度使，上命大臣議之。

translations.literal: Chao again submitted a memorial requesting the Guangzhou military governorship; the emperor ordered the grand ministers to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Chao again memorialized requesting the Guangzhou military governorship, and the emperor ordered deliberation among the grand ministers

sentences.zh: 左僕射于琮以為：「廣州市舶寶貨所聚，豈可令賊得之！」

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Yu Cong held: "Guangzhou is where maritime-trade treasure goods gather—how can the bandits be allowed to obtain it!"
translations.idiomatic: Left vice director Yu Cong said, "Guangzhou is where the sea-trade treasure gathers. You would give that to thieves?

sentences.zh: 亦不許，乃議別除官。

translations.literal: This too was not permitted, and they then deliberated appointing another office.
translations.idiomatic: That too was refused, and they deliberated appointing him to another office

sentences.zh: 六月，宰相請除巢率府率，從之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the grand councillors requested appointing Chao Chamberlain of the Crown Prince's Household; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the grand councillors requested appointing Chao chamberlain of the crown prince's household; the request was granted

sentences.zh: 河東節度使李侃以軍府數有亂，稱疾，請尋醫。

translations.literal: Hedong military governor Li Kan, because the army headquarters had repeatedly suffered disturbances, claimed illness and requested leave to seek medical treatment.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong military governor Li Kan, because headquarters had repeatedly suffered disturbances, claimed illness and asked leave to seek treatment

sentences.zh: 敕以代州刺史康傳圭為河東行軍司馬，征侃詣京師。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Dai prefecture prefect Kang Chuangu as Hedong acting army commander and summoned Kan to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Daizhou prefect Kang Chuangu Hedong acting army commander and summoned Kan to the capital

sentences.zh: 秋，八月，甲子，侃發晉陽。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on jiazi, Kan set out from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, on jiazi, Kan departed Jinyang

sentences.zh: 尋以東都留守節蔚同平章事，充河東節度使。

translations.literal: Soon eastern capital regent Li Wei was made Grand Councillor and appointed Hedong military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon eastern capital regent Li Wei was appointed grand councillor and Hedong military governor

sentences.zh: 鎮海節度使高駢奏：「請以權舒州刺史郎幼復充留後，守浙西，遣都知兵馬使張璘將兵五千於郴州守險，兵馬留後王重任將兵八千於循、潮二州邀遮，臣將萬人自大庾嶺趣廣州，擊黃。

translations.literal: Zhenhai military governor Gao Pian memorialized: "I ask that acting Shu prefecture prefect Lang Youfu be made acting regent and hold western Zhe; that director of military affairs Zhang Lin lead five thousand troops to garrison Chen prefecture and hold the passes; that military affairs acting regent Wang Zhongren lead eight thousand troops at Xun and Chao prefectures to intercept; and that your servant lead ten thousand men over Dayu Range toward Guangzhou to strike Huang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenhai military governor Gao Pian memorialized: "I ask that acting Shu prefect Lang Youfu be made acting regent to hold western Zhe; that director of military affairs Zhang Lin lead five thousand troops to garrison Chenzhou and hold the passes; that military affairs acting regent Wang Zhongren lead eight thousand at Xun and Chaozhou to intercept; and that I lead ten thousand over Dayu Range toward Guangzhou to strike Huang

sentences.zh: 巢聞臣往，必當遁逃，乞敕王鐸以所部兵三萬於梧、昭、桂、永四州守險。」

translations.literal: When Chao hears that I am coming, he is sure to flee; I beg an order for Wang Duo to station thirty thousand of his troops at Wu, Zhao, Gui, and Yong prefectures to hold the passes."
translations.idiomatic: When Chao hears I am coming, he will surely flee. I beg an order for Wang Duo to station thirty thousand troops at Wu, Zhao, Gui, and Yong to hold the passes

sentences.zh: 詔不許。

translations.literal: The edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The edict refused

sentences.zh: 九月，黃巢得率府率告身，大怒，詬執政，急攻廣州，即日陷之，執節度使李迢，轉掠嶺南州縣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Huang Chao received the appointment notice as Chamberlain of the Crown Prince's Household, was greatly angered, reviled the chief ministers, urgently attacked Guangzhou, took it the same day, seized military governor Li Tiao, and turned to plunder the prefectures and counties of Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Huang Chao received his appointment as chamberlain of the crown prince's household. He raged, cursed the ministers, stormed Guangzhou, took it the same day, seized Li Tiao, and swept through Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 巢使迢草表述其所懷，迢曰：「予代受國恩，親戚滿朝，腕可斷，表不可草。」

translations.literal: Chao had Tiao draft a memorial stating his grievances; Tiao said: "I have received the state's grace in succession; my kin fill the court. My wrist may be severed, but the memorial I will not draft."
translations.idiomatic: Chao ordered Tiao to draft a memorial of grievance. Tiao said, "I owe the state my life; my kin fill the court. Cut off my wrist—I will not write."

sentences.zh: 巢殺之。

translations.literal: Chao killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Chao killed him

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，以鎮海節度使高駢為淮南節度使，充鹽鐵轉運使，以涇原節度使周寶為鎮海節度使，以山南東道行軍司馬劉臣容為節度使。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Zhenhai military governor Gao Pian was made Huainan military governor and salt and iron transport commissioner; Jingyuan military governor Zhou Bao was made Zhenhai military governor; Shannan East Circuit acting army commander Liu Jurong was made military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, Zhenhai military governor Gao Pian was made Huainan military governor and salt and iron transport commissioner; Jingyuan military governor Zhou Bao was made Zhenhai military governor; Shannan East Circuit acting army commander Liu Jurong was made military governor

sentences.zh: 寶，平州人也。

translations.literal: Bao was a man of Ping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Bao was from Pingzhou

sentences.zh: 黃巢在嶺南，士卒罹瘴疫死者什三四，其徒勸之北還以圖大事，巢從之。

translations.literal: Huang Chao was in Lingnan; three or four tenths of his soldiers died from malarial pestilence; his followers urged him to return north to pursue the great design, and Chao agreed.
translations.idiomatic: In Lingnan, malarial pestilence killed three or four men in ten. His followers urged a northern return to seize the greater prize, and Chao agreed.

sentences.zh: 自桂州編大筏靈數千，乘暴水，沿湘江而下，歷衡、永州，癸未，抵潭州城下。

translations.literal: From Gui prefecture he lashed together several thousand large rafts, rode the flood waters, descended along the Xiang River, passed Heng and Yong prefectures, and on guwei reached below the walls of Tan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: From Guizhou he lashed together several thousand large rafts, rode the floodwaters down the Xiang River, passed Heng and Yong, and on guwei reached the walls of Tanzhou

sentences.zh: 李系嬰城不敢出戰，巢急攻，一日，陷之，系奔朗州。

translations.literal: Li Xi defended the city but dared not give battle; Chao pressed the attack, and in one day took it; Xi fled to Lang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xi shut the gates and would not fight. Chao pressed hard and took the city in a day. Xi fled to Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 巢盡殺戍兵，流屍蔽江而下。

translations.literal: Chao killed all the garrison troops; floating corpses covered the river downstream.
translations.idiomatic: Chao slaughtered the garrison. Corpses choked the river downstream.

sentences.zh: 尚讓乘勝進逼江陵，眾號五十萬。

translations.literal: Shang Rang, pressing the victory, advanced to threaten Jiangling; the host was proclaimed at five hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Rang pressed the victory and advanced on Jiangling. The host was proclaimed at five hundred thousand

sentences.zh: 時諸道兵未集，江陵兵不滿萬人，王鐸留其將劉漢宏守江陵，自帥眾趣襄陽，雲欲會劉巨容之師。

translations.literal: At the time troops from the various circuits had not yet assembled; Jiangling had fewer than ten thousand soldiers. Wang Duo left his general Liu Hanhong to hold Jiangling and himself led his host toward Xiangyang, saying he wished to join Liu Jurong's army.
translations.idiomatic: The circuits had not yet mustered; Jiangling held fewer than ten thousand. Wang Duo left Liu Hanhong to guard the city and marched for Xiangyang, claiming he would join Liu Jurong.

sentences.zh: 鐸既去，漢寵大掠江陵，焚蕩殆盡，士民逃竄山谷。

translations.literal: Once Duo had gone, Hanhong plundered Jiangling on a great scale, burned and ravaged nearly everything, and gentry and commoners fled into the mountain valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Once Duo was gone, Hanhong plundered Jiangling, burned it nearly bare, and drove gentry and commoners into the hills.

sentences.zh: 會大雪，殭屍滿野。

translations.literal: It happened to snow heavily; frozen corpses filled the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Snow fell heavily. Frozen dead filled the fields.

sentences.zh: 後旬餘，賊乃至。

translations.literal: More than ten days later the bandits arrived.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten days later the rebels arrived

sentences.zh: 漢宏，兗州人也，帥其眾北歸為群盜。

translations.literal: Hanhong was a man of Yan prefecture; he led his host north and became a bandit chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Hanhong was from Yanzhou. He led his followers north and became a bandit chieftain

sentences.zh: 閏月，丁亥朔，河東節度使李蔚有疾，以供軍副使李邵權觀察留後，監軍李奉皋權兵馬留後。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the dinghai new moon, Hedong military governor Li Wei was ill; army-supply deputy Li Shao was made acting observation regent, and army supervisor Li Fenggao was made acting military affairs regent.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the dinghai new moon, Hedong military governor Li Wei fell ill. Army-supply deputy Li Shao was made acting observation regent, and army supervisor Li Fenggao acting military affairs regent

sentences.zh: 己丑，蔚薨。

translations.literal: On jichou, Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Wei died

sentences.zh: 都虞侯張鍇、郭昢署狀納邵，以少尹丁球知觀察留後。

translations.literal: Chief adjutants Zhang Kai and Guo Fen signed a petition installing Shao; junior administrator Ding Qiu was made acting observation regent.
translations.idiomatic: Chief adjutants Zhang Kai and Guo Fen signed a petition installing Shao; junior administrator Ding Qiu was made acting observation regent

sentences.zh: 十一月，戊午，以定州已來制置使萬年王處存為義武節度使、河東行軍司馬，雁門關已來制置使康傳圭為河東節度使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuwu, Ding prefecture-and-below disposition commissioner Wang Chucun of Wannian was made Yiwu military governor and Hedong acting army commander, and Yanmen Pass-and-below disposition commissioner Kang Chuangu was made Hedong military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuwu, disposition commissioner from Dingzhou southward Wang Chucun of Wannian was made Yiwu military governor and Hedong acting army commander, and disposition commissioner from Yanmen Pass southward Kang Chuangu was made Hedong military governor

sentences.zh: 黃巢北趣襄陽，劉巨容與江西招討使淄州刺史曹全晸合兵，屯荊門以拒之。

translations.literal: Huang Chao marched north toward Xiangyang; Liu Jurong and Jiangxi pacification commissioner Zi prefecture prefect Cao Quanzhen combined forces and encamped at Jingmen to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao marched north toward Xiangyang. Liu Jurong and Jiangxi pacification commissioner Zi prefect Cao Quanzhen combined forces and encamped at Jingmen to block him

sentences.zh: 賊至，巨容伏兵林中，全晸以輕騎逆戰，陽不勝而走。

translations.literal: When the bandits arrived, Jurong hid troops in the forest; Quanzhen with light cavalry offered battle, feigning defeat and fleeing.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels arrived, Jurong hid troops in the forest. Quanzhen offered battle with light cavalry, feigned defeat, and fled

sentences.zh: 賊追之，伏發，大破賊眾，乘勝逐北。

translations.literal: The bandits pursued; the ambush struck, and the rebel host was greatly defeated; pressing the victory they pursued north.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels pursued; the ambush struck and routed them. Pressing the victory, the government forces pursued north

sentences.zh: 比至江陵，俘斬其什七八。

translations.literal: By the time they reached Jiangling, seven or eight tenths of the bandits had been captured or beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: By the time they reached Jiangling, seven or eight tenths of the rebels had been captured or killed

sentences.zh: 巢與尚讓收餘眾渡江東走。

translations.literal: Chao and Shang Rang gathered the remnant host, crossed the river, and fled east.
translations.idiomatic: Chao and Shang Rang gathered the remnants, crossed the river, and fled east

sentences.zh: 或勸巨容窮追，賊可盡也。

translations.literal: Some urged Jurong to pursue to the end, saying the bandits could be wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: Some urged Jurong to pursue to the end and wipe out the rebels

sentences.zh: 巨容曰：「國家喜負人，有急則撫存將士，不愛官賞，事寧則棄之，或更得罪。

translations.literal: Jurong said: "The state delights in betraying men; when there is urgency it soothes and keeps the officers and soldiers, sparing no offices or rewards, but when affairs are settled it casts them aside, and they may even incur guilt anew.
translations.idiomatic: Jurong said, "The court loves to betray its soldiers. In crisis it pampers them with rank and gold; when peace returns it casts them off—or punishes them again.

sentences.zh: 不若留賊以為富貴之資。」

translations.literal: Better to leave the bandits as capital for wealth and rank."
translations.idiomatic: Leave the bandits alive, and wealth and office will keep coming.

sentences.zh: 眾乃止。

translations.literal: The host then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The pursuit stopped

sentences.zh: 全晸度江追賊，會朝廷以泰寧都將段彥謨代為招討使，全晸亦止。

translations.literal: Quanzhen crossed the river in pursuit of the bandits; just then the court appointed Taining general Duan Yanmo to replace him as pacification commissioner, and Quanzhen also stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhen crossed the river in pursuit, but the court appointed Taining general Duan Yanmo to replace him as pacification commissioner, and he stopped

sentences.zh: 由是賊勢復振，攻鄂州，陷其外郭，轉掠饒、信、池、宣、歙、杭等十五州，眾至二十萬。

translations.literal: Thereby the bandits' power revived; they attacked E prefecture, took its outer wall, and turned to plunder Rao, Xin, Chi, Xuan, She, Hang, and other fifteen prefectures; the host reached two hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels rallied. They took the outer wall of Ezhou and ravaged fifteen prefectures—Rao, Xin, Chi, Xuan, She, Hang, and the rest—until their host reached two hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 康傳圭自代州赴晉陽，庚辰，至烏城驛。

translations.literal: Kang Chuangu set out from Dai prefecture for Jinyang; on gengchen he reached Wucheng post station.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Chuangu set out from Daizhou for Jinyang. On gengchen he reached Wucheng post station

sentences.zh: 張鍇、郭昢出迎，亂刀斫殺之，至府，又族其家。

translations.literal: Zhang Kai and Guo Fen came out to welcome him, hacked him to death with disorderly blades, and upon reaching the prefectural office exterminated his clan as well.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Kai and Guo Fen came out to welcome Kang Chuangu, cut him down in a frenzy of blades, and at headquarters exterminated his clan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以王鐸為太子賓客、分司。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wang Duo was made Crown Prince's Adviser with separate office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Wang Duo was appointed crown prince's adviser with separate commission

sentences.zh: 初，兵部尚書盧攜嘗薦高駢可為都統，至是，駢將張璘等屢破黃巢，乃復以攜為門下侍郎、平章事，凡關東節度使，王鐸、鄭畋所除者，多易置之。

translations.literal: Initially, Minister of War Lu Xie had once recommended Gao Pian as suitable for overall command; now that Pian's generals Zhang Lin and others had repeatedly defeated Huang Chao, Lu Xie was restored as Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councillor, and most of the eastern circuit military governors appointed by Wang Duo and Zheng Tian were replaced.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, Minister of War Lu Xie had once recommended Gao Pian as suitable for overall command. Now that Pian's generals Zhang Lin and others had repeatedly defeated Huang Chao, Lu Xie was restored as vice director of the chancellery and grand councillor, and most of the eastern circuit military governors appointed by Wang Duo and Zheng Tian were replaced.

sentences.zh: 是歲，桂陽賊陳彥廉陷郴州，殺刺史董岳。

translations.literal: That year, the Guiyang bandit Chen Yanlian took Chen prefecture and killed Prefect Dong Yue.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the Guiyang bandit Chen Yanlian took Chen prefecture and killed Prefect Dong Yue.

sentences.zh: 僖宗聖恭定孝皇帝上之下廣明元年（庚子，公元八八零年） 。

translations.literal: Emperor Xizong the Sagely, Respectful, Settled, and Filial—lower part of the Upper Annals—Guangming year 1 (gengzi, 880 CE).
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xizong the Sagely, Respectful, Settled, and Filial—lower portion of the Upper Annals—Guangming year 1 (gengzi, 880 CE)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，乙卯朔，改元。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the yimao new moon, the reign era was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, first month, on the yimao new moon, the reign era was changed.

sentences.zh: 沙陀入雁門關，寇忻、代。

translations.literal: The Shatuo entered Yanmen Pass and raided Xin and Dai.
translations.idiomatic: The Shatuo entered Yanmen Pass and raided Xin and Dai.

sentences.zh: 二月，庚戌，沙陀二萬餘人逼晉陽，辛亥，陷太谷。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengxu, more than twenty thousand Shatuo pressed Jinyang; on xinhai they took Taigu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengxu, more than twenty thousand Shatuo pressed Jinyang. On xinhai they took Taigu.

sentences.zh: 遣汝州防禦使博昌諸葛爽帥東都防禦兵救河東。

translations.literal: The court dispatched Bochang's Zhuge Shuang, defense commissioner of Ru prefecture, to lead the eastern capital defense troops to rescue Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: The court dispatched Bochang's Zhuge Shuang, defense commissioner of Ru prefecture, to lead the eastern capital defense troops to rescue Hedong.

sentences.zh: 河東節度使康傳圭，專事威刑，多復仇怨，強取富人財。

translations.literal: Kang Chuanguì, military governor of Hedong, relied exclusively on harsh punishments, nursed many vendettas, and forcibly seized the wealth of the rich.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Chuanguì, military governor of Hedong, relied exclusively on harsh punishments, nursed many vendettas, and forcibly seized the wealth of the rich.

sentences.zh: 遣前遮虜軍使蘇弘軫擊沙陀於太谷，至秦城，遇沙陀，戰不利而還，傳圭怒，斬弘軫。

translations.literal: He sent former Barrier Army commander Su Hongzhen to strike the Shatuo at Taigu; reaching Qincheng they met the Shatuo, fought without success and withdrew; Chuanguì was enraged and executed Hongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He sent former Barrier Army commander Su Hongzhen to strike the Shatuo at Taigu. Reaching Qincheng they met the Shatuo, fought without success and withdrew. Chuanguì was enraged and executed Hongzhen.

sentences.zh: 時沙陀已還代北。

translations.literal: By then the Shatuo had already returned to northern Dai.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Shatuo had already returned to northern Dai.

sentences.zh: 傳圭遣都教練使張彥球將兵三千追之。

translations.literal: Chuanguì sent chief training officer Zhang Yanqiu with three thousand troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Chuanguì sent chief training officer Zhang Yanqiu with three thousand troops in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，至百井，軍變，還趣晉陽。

translations.literal: On renxu, at Baijing, the army mutinied and turned back toward Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, at Baijing, the army mutinied and turned back toward Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 傳圭閉城拒之，亂兵自西明門入，殺傳圭。

translations.literal: Chuanguì shut the city against them; the mutineers entered through the Ximing Gate and killed Chuanguì.
translations.idiomatic: Chuanguì shut the city against them. The mutineers entered through the Ximing Gate and killed Chuanguì.

sentences.zh: 監軍周從寓自出慰諭，乃定，以彥球為府城都虞候。

translations.literal: Supervising eunuch Zhou Congyu went out himself to pacify them, and order was restored; Yanqiu was made chief adjutant of the headquarters city.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising eunuch Zhou Congyu went out himself to pacify them, and order was restored. Yanqiu was made chief adjutant of the headquarters city.

sentences.zh: 朝廷聞之，遣使宣尉曰：「所殺節度使，事出一時，各宜自安，勿復憂懼。」

translations.literal: When the court heard of it, it sent an envoy to announce reassurance: "The military governor who was killed—this arose in a single moment; each of you should settle your minds and fear no more.
translations.idiomatic: When the court heard of it, it sent an envoy to announce reassurance: "The military governor who was killed—this arose in a single moment. Each of you should settle your minds and fear no more.

sentences.zh: 左拾遺侯昌業以盜賊滿關東，而上不親政事，專務遊戲，賞賜無度，田令孜專權無上，天文變異，社稷將危，上疏極諫。

translations.literal: Left Reminder Hou Changye, because bandits filled the eastern circuits while the emperor did not attend to state affairs himself but devoted himself to games, bestowed rewards without limit, Tian Lingzi wielded unchecked power, celestial signs changed, and the altars of state were in peril, submitted a memorial of the strongest remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: Left Reminder Hou Changye submitted a memorial of the strongest remonstrance: bandits filled the eastern circuits, the emperor did not attend to state affairs but devoted himself to games, rewards were bestowed without limit, Tian Lingzi wielded unchecked power, celestial signs changed, and the altars of state were in peril.

sentences.zh: 上大怒，召昌業至內侍省，賜死。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly enraged, summoned Changye to the Directorate of Palace Attendants, and had him put to death.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly enraged, summoned Changye to the Directorate of Palace Attendants, and had him put to death.

sentences.zh: 上好騎射、劍槊、法算，至於音律、蒱博，無不精妙；

translations.literal: The emperor loved horseback archery, sword and spear, and reckoning; in music and gambling too he was without peer in refinement;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor loved horseback archery, sword and spear, and reckoning; in music and gambling too he was without peer in refinement.

sentences.zh: 好蹴鞠、鬥雞，與諸王賭鵝，鵝一頭至直五十緡。

translations.literal: he loved cuju and cockfighting, wagered geese with the princes, and a single goose could fetch as much as fifty strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: He loved cuju and cockfighting, wagered geese with the princes, and a single goose could fetch as much as fifty strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 尤善擊球，嘗謂優人石野獵曰：朕若應擊球進士舉，須為狀元。」

translations.literal: He was especially skilled at polo, and once said to the actor Shi Yelie: "If I entered the polo examination for the jinshi degree, I would have to come out first."
translations.idiomatic: He was especially skilled at polo, and once said to the actor Shi Yelie, "If I entered the polo examination for the jinshi degree, I would have to come out first."

sentences.zh: 對曰：「若遇堯、舜作禮部侍郎，恐陛下不免駁放。」

translations.literal: He replied: "If Yao and Shun were Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites, I fear Your Majesty would still fail the examination."
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "If Yao and Shun were vice director of the Ministry of Rites, I fear Your Majesty would still fail the examination.

sentences.zh: 上笑而已。

translations.literal: The emperor only laughed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor only laughed.

sentences.zh: 度支以用度不足，奏借富戶及胡商貨財。

translations.literal: The Department of Public Revenue, because expenditures were insufficient, memorialized to borrow the property of wealthy households and foreign merchants.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of Public Revenue, because expenditures were insufficient, memorialized to borrow the property of wealthy households and foreign merchants.

sentences.zh: 敕借其半。

translations.literal: An edict ordered half of it borrowed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered half of it borrowed.

sentences.zh: 鹽鐵轉運使高駢上言：「天下盜賊蜂起，皆出於饑寒，獨富戶、胡商未耳。」

translations.literal: Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner Gao Pian submitted a memorial: "Bandits are rising everywhere under Heaven, all because of hunger and cold; only the wealthy households and foreign merchants are untouched."
translations.idiomatic: Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner Gao Pian submitted a memorial: "Bandits are rising everywhere under Heaven, all because of hunger and cold; only the wealthy households and foreign merchants are untouched.

sentences.zh: 乃止。

translations.literal: Thereupon the plan was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the plan was halted.

sentences.zh: 高駢奏改楊子院為發運使。

translations.literal: Gao Pian memorialized to change the Yangzi Office into a transport commission.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Pian memorialized to change the Yangzi Office into a transport commission.

sentences.zh: 三月，庚午，以左金吾大將軍陳敬瑄為西川節度使。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengwu, Left Golden Guard General Chen Jingxuan was made military governor of Xichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengwu, Left Golden Guard General Chen Jingxuan was made military governor of Xichuan.

sentences.zh: 敬瑄，許州人，田令孜之兄也。

translations.literal: Jingxuan was a man of Xu prefecture and elder brother of Tian Lingzi.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan was a man of Xu prefecture and elder brother of Tian Lingzi.

sentences.zh: 初，崔安潛鎮許昌，令孜為敬瑄求兵馬使，安潛不許。

translations.literal: Initially, when Cui Anqian governed Xuchang, Lingzi sought for Jingxuan the post of army and horse commissioner; Anqian did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, when Cui Anqian governed Xuchang, Lingzi sought for Jingxuan the post of army and horse commissioner; Anqian did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 敬瑄因令孜得錄左神策軍，數歲，累遷至大將軍。

translations.literal: Through Lingzi, Jingxuan obtained enrollment in the Left Divine Strategy Army; over several years he rose repeatedly to great general.
translations.idiomatic: Through Lingzi, Jingxuan obtained enrollment in the Left Divine Strategy Army; over several years he rose repeatedly to great general.

sentences.zh: 令孜見關東群盜日熾，陰為幸蜀之計，奏以敬瑄及其腹心左神策大將軍楊師立、牛勖、羅元杲鎮三川，上令四人擊球賭三川，敬瑄得第一籌，即以為西川節度使，代安潛。

translations.literal: Lingzi saw the eastern bandits growing fiercer by the day and secretly laid plans to flee to Shu; he memorialized that Jingxuan and his trusted men—Left Divine Strategy great generals Yang Shili, Niu Xu, and Luo Yuangao—should govern the Three Circuits. The emperor had the four men play polo for the Three Circuits; Jingxuan drew the first token and was immediately made military governor of Xichuan, replacing Anqian.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzi saw the eastern bandits growing fiercer by the day and secretly laid plans to flee to Shu. He memorialized that Jingxuan and his trusted men—Left Divine Strategy great generals Yang Shili, Niu Xu, and Luo Yuangao—should govern the Three Circuits. The emperor had the four men play polo for the Three Circuits; Jingxuan drew the first token and was immediately made military governor of Xichuan, replacing Anqian.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以門侍郎、同平章事鄭從讜同平章事，充河東節度使。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Gate Director and Associate Grand Councillor Zheng Congdan was made associate grand councillor and military governor of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, gate director and associate grand councillor Zheng Congdan was made associate grand councillor and military governor of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 康傳圭既死，河東兵益驕，故以宰相鎮之，使自擇參佐。

translations.literal: After Kang Chuanguì's death the Hedong troops grew still more insolent; therefore a grand councillor was sent to govern them, allowed to choose his own staff.
translations.idiomatic: After Kang Chuanguì's death the Hedong troops grew still more insolent; therefore a grand councillor was sent to govern them, allowed to choose his own staff.

sentences.zh: 從讜奏以長安令王調為節度副使，前後部員外郎、史館修撰劉崇龜為節度判官，前司勳員外郎、史館修撰趙崇為觀察判官，前進士劉崇魯為推官。

translations.literal: Congdan memorialized to appoint Chang'an Magistrate Wang Diao deputy military governor, former Department of State Affairs aide and Historiography compiler Liu Chonggui military affairs judge, former Ministry of Personnel aide and Historiography compiler Zhao Chong observation judge, and former jinshi Liu Chonglu investigating officer.
translations.idiomatic: Congdan memorialized to appoint Chang'an Magistrate Wang Diao deputy military governor, former Department of State Affairs aide and historiography compiler Liu Chonggui military affairs judge, former Ministry of Personnel aide and historiography compiler Zhao Chong observation judge, and former jinshi Liu Chonglu investigating officer.

sentences.zh: 時人謂之小朝廷，言名士之多也。

translations.literal: People of the time called it a little court, meaning how many eminent men there were.
translations.idiomatic: People of the time called it a little court, meaning how many eminent men there were.

sentences.zh: 崇龜、崇魯，政會之七世孫也。

translations.literal: Chonggui and Chonglu were seventh-generation descendants of Liu Zhenghui.
translations.idiomatic: Chonggui and Chonglu were seventh-generation descendants of Liu Zhenghui.

sentences.zh: 時承晉陽新亂之後，日有殺掠，從讜貌溫而氣勁，多謀而善斷，將士欲為惡者，從讜輒先覺，誅之，奸猾惕息。

translations.literal: At the time, in the aftermath of the fresh turmoil at Jinyang, killings and plunder occurred daily; Congdan's bearing was mild but his spirit was forceful, he was full of plans and good at decisions, and whenever the officers and soldiers meant to do evil he foresaw it and executed them, so the cunning grew wary and fell silent.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, in the aftermath of the fresh turmoil at Jinyang, killings and plunder occurred daily. Congdan's bearing was mild but his spirit was forceful; he was full of plans and good at decisions. Whenever the officers and soldiers meant to do evil he foresaw it and executed them, so the cunning grew wary and fell silent.

sentences.zh: 為善者撫待無疑，知張彥球有方略，百井之變，非本心，獨推首亂者殺之，召彥球慰諭，悉以兵柄委之，軍中由是遂安。

translations.literal: Those who meant to do good he treated without suspicion; knowing Zhang Yanqiu had strategy, and that the Baijing mutiny was not from his heart, he alone executed the ringleaders and killed them, summoned Yanqiu to reassure him, and entrusted all military authority to him; the army thereafter settled.
translations.idiomatic: Those who meant to do good he treated without suspicion. Knowing Zhang Yanqiu had strategy and that the Baijing mutiny was not from his heart, he alone executed the ringleaders, summoned Yanqiu to reassure him, and entrusted all military authority to him; the army thereafter settled.

sentences.zh: 彥球為從讜盡死力，卒獲其用。

translations.literal: Yanqiu gave Congdan his utmost loyalty and in the end proved fully useful.
translations.idiomatic: Yanqiu gave Congdan his utmost loyalty and in the end proved fully useful.

sentences.zh: 淮南節度使高駢遣其將張璘等擊黃巢屢捷，盧攜奏以駢為諸道行營兵馬都統。

translations.literal: Huainan Military Governor Gao Pian sent his generals Zhang Lin and others to strike Huang Chao with repeated victories; Lu Xie memorialized to make Pian overall commander of the expeditionary armies of all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan military governor Gao Pian sent his generals Zhang Lin and others to strike Huang Chao with repeated victories; Lu Xie memorialized to make Pian overall commander of the expeditionary armies of all circuits.

sentences.zh: 駢乃傳檄征天下兵，且廣召募，得土客之兵共七萬，威望大振，朝廷深倚之。

translations.literal: Pian then issued a proclamation summoning troops from all under Heaven and widely recruiting as well, obtaining seventy thousand local and guest soldiers; his prestige surged greatly and the court relied on him deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Pian then issued a proclamation summoning troops from all under Heaven and widely recruiting as well, obtaining seventy thousand local and guest soldiers. His prestige surged greatly and the court relied on him deeply.

sentences.zh: 安南軍亂，節度使曾袞出城避之，諸道兵戍邕管者往往自歸。

translations.literal: The Annan army mutinied; Military Governor Zeng Gun fled the city to avoid them, and troops from various circuits garrisoning Yong and Guan often returned on their own.
translations.idiomatic: The Annan army mutinied; military governor Zeng Gun fled the city to avoid them, and troops from various circuits garrisoning Yong and Guan often returned on their own.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丁酉，以太僕卿李琢為蔚、朔等州招討都統、行營節度使。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on dingyou, Grand Stablemaster Li Zhuo was made overall pacification commissioner of Wei, Shuo, and other prefectures and expeditionary military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, on dingyou, grand stablemaster Li Zhuo was made overall pacification commissioner of Wei, Shuo, and other prefectures and expeditionary military governor.

sentences.zh: 琢，聽之子也。

translations.literal: Zhuo was a son of Li Ting.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo was a son of Li Ting.

sentences.zh: 張璘渡江擊賊帥王重霸，降之。

translations.literal: Zhang Lin crossed the river to strike the bandit chief Wang Chongba and made him surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Lin crossed the river to strike the bandit chief Wang Chongba and made him surrender.

sentences.zh: 屢破黃巢軍，巢退保饒州，別將常宏以其眾數萬降。

translations.literal: He repeatedly defeated Huang Chao's army; Chao withdrew to hold Raozhou, and a separate commander, Chang Hong, surrendered with his host of tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly defeated Huang Chao's army. Chao withdrew to hold Raozhou, and a separate commander, Chang Hong, surrendered with his host of tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 璘攻饒州，克之，巢走。

translations.literal: Lin attacked Raozhou, took it, and Chao fled.
translations.idiomatic: Lin attacked Raozhou, took it, and Chao fled.

sentences.zh: 時江、淮諸軍屢奏破賊，率皆不實，宰相已下表賀，朝廷差以自安。

translations.literal: At the time the Jiang and Huai armies repeatedly memorialized victories over the bandits, but most were untrue; the grand councillors and below submitted congratulatory memorials, and the court was somewhat reassured.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Jiang and Huai armies repeatedly memorialized victories over the bandits, but most were untrue; the grand councillors and below submitted congratulatory memorials, and the court was somewhat reassured.

sentences.zh: 以李琢為蔚朔節度使，仍充都統。

translations.literal: Li Zhuo was made military governor of Wei and Shuo while still serving as overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhuo was made military governor of Wei and Shuo while still serving as overall commander.

sentences.zh: 以楊師立為東川節度使，牛勖為山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Yang Shili was made military governor of Dongchuan, and Niu Xu military governor of Shannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shili was made military governor of Dongchuan, and Niu Xu military governor of Shannan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 以諸葛爽為北面行營副招討。

translations.literal: Zhuge Shuang was made deputy overall pacification commissioner of the Northern Expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuge Shuang was made deputy overall pacification commissioner of the Northern Expedition.

sentences.zh: 初，劉巨容既還襄陽，荊南監軍楊復光以忠武都將宋浩權知府事，泰寧都將段彥謨以兵守其城。

translations.literal: Initially, after Liu Jurong had returned to Xiangyang, Jingnan supervising eunuch Yang Fuguang had Zhongwu chief general Song Hao act as provisional prefect, and Taining chief general Duan Yanmo hold the city with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, after Liu Jurong had returned to Xiangyang, Jingnan supervising eunuch Yang Fuguang had Zhongwu chief general Song Hao act as provisional prefect, and Taining chief general Duan Yanmo hold the city with troops.

sentences.zh: 詔以浩為荊南安撫使，彥謨恥居其下。

translations.literal: An edict made Hao Jingnan pacification commissioner; Yanmo was shamed to serve beneath him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Hao Jingnan pacification commissioner; Yanmo was shamed to serve beneath him.

sentences.zh: 浩禁軍士翦伐街中槐柳，彥謨部卒犯令，浩杖其背。

translations.literal: Hao forbade the soldiers to cut down the pagoda trees in the streets; Yanmo's troops violated the order, and Hao caned their backs.
translations.idiomatic: Hao forbade the soldiers to cut down the pagoda trees in the streets; Yanmo's troops violated the order, and Hao caned their backs.

sentences.zh: 彥謨怒，扶刃馳入，並其二子殺之。

translations.literal: Yanmo was enraged, drew his blade and galloped in, and killed Hao together with his two sons.
translations.idiomatic: Yanmo was enraged, drew his blade and galloped in, and killed Hao together with his two sons.

sentences.zh: 復光奏浩殘酷，為眾所誅。

translations.literal: Fuguang memorialized that Hao had been cruel and was executed by the host.
translations.idiomatic: Fuguang memorialized that Hao had been cruel and was executed by the host.

sentences.zh: 詔以彥謨為朗州刺史，以工部侍郎鄭紹業為荊南節度使。

translations.literal: An edict made Yanmo prefect of Lang, and Ministry of Works Vice Director Zheng Shaoye military governor of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Yanmo prefect of Lang, and Ministry of Works vice director Zheng Shaoye military governor of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 五月，丁巳，以汝州防禦使諸葛爽為振武節度使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingsi, Zhuge Shuang, defense commissioner of Ru prefecture, was made military governor of Zhenwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingsi, Zhuge Shuang, defense commissioner of Ru prefecture, was made military governor of Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 劉漢宏之黨浸盛，侵掠宋、兗。

translations.literal: The faction of Liu Hanhong grew ever stronger and raided Song and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The faction of Liu Hanhong grew ever stronger and raided Song and Yan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，征東方諸道兵討之。

translations.literal: On jiazi, troops from the eastern circuits were mobilized to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, troops from the eastern circuits were mobilized to attack them.

sentences.zh: 黃巢屯信州，遇疾疫，卒徒多死。

translations.literal: Huang Chao encamped at Xin prefecture, encountered pestilence, and many of his soldiers and followers died.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao encamped at Xin prefecture, encountered pestilence, and many of his soldiers and followers died.

sentences.zh: 張璘急擊之，巢以金啖璘，且致書請降於高駢，求駢保奏。

translations.literal: Zhang Lin pressed the attack; Chao bribed Lin with gold and also sent a letter requesting surrender to Gao Pian, asking Pian to guarantee the memorial for him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Lin pressed the attack. Chao bribed Lin with gold and also sent a letter requesting surrender to Gao Pian, asking Pian to guarantee the memorial for him.

sentences.zh: 駢欲誘致之，許為之求節鉞。

translations.literal: Pian wished to lure him in and promised to seek a commission and credentials for him.
translations.idiomatic: Pian wished to lure him in and promised to seek a commission and credentials for him.

sentences.zh: 時昭義、感化、義武等軍皆至淮南，駢恐分其功，乃奏賊不日當平，不煩諸道兵，請悉遣歸。

translations.literal: At the time the Zhaoyi, Ganhua, and Yiwu armies had all reached Huainan; Pian feared they would divide his credit and memorialized that the bandits would soon be pacified and the armies of the various circuits need not trouble themselves, asking that all be sent back.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Zhaoyi, Ganhua, and Yiwu armies had all reached Huainan; Pian feared they would divide his credit and memorialized that the bandits would soon be pacified and the armies of the various circuits need not trouble themselves, asking that all be sent back.

sentences.zh: 朝廷許之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 賊詗知諸道兵已北渡淮，乃告絕於駢，且請戰。

translations.literal: The bandits learned by espionage that the armies of the various circuits had already crossed north of the Huai, broke off with Pian, and requested battle.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits learned by espionage that the armies of the various circuits had already crossed north of the Huai, broke off with Pian, and requested battle.

sentences.zh: 駢怒，令璘擊之，兵敗，璘死，巢勢復振。

translations.literal: Pian was enraged and ordered Lin to attack; the army was defeated, Lin died, and Chao's power revived.
translations.idiomatic: Pian was enraged and ordered Lin to attack; the army was defeated, Lin died, and Chao's power revived.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以樞密使西門思恭鳳翔監軍。

translations.literal: On yihai, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Ximen Sigong was made Fengxiang supervising army.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, palace secretariat commissioner Ximen Sigong was made Fengxiang supervising army.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以宣徽使李順融為樞密使。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Palace Emissary Li Shunrong was made palace secretariat commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, palace emissary Li Shunrong was made palace secretariat commissioner.

sentences.zh: 皆降白麻，於閤門出案，與將相同。

translations.literal: Both received white hemp edicts; the cases were issued at the Gate of Receiving Mandates, the same as for generals.
translations.idiomatic: Both received white hemp edicts; the cases were issued at the Gate of Receiving Mandates, the same as for generals.

sentences.zh: 西川節度使陳敬瑄素微賤，報至蜀，蜀人皆驚，莫知為誰。

translations.literal: Xichuan Military Governor Chen Jingxuan had always been of humble origin; when the appointment reached Shu, the people of Shu were all astonished and did not know who he was.
translations.idiomatic: Xichuan military governor Chen Jingxuan had always been of humble origin; when the appointment reached Shu, the people of Shu were all astonished and did not know who he was.

sentences.zh: 有青城妖人乘其聲勢，帥其黨詐稱陳僕射，止逆旅，呼巡虞候索白馬甚急。

translations.literal: A sorcerer of Qingcheng, riding the commotion, led his faction falsely claiming to be Vice Director Chen, stopped at an inn, and urgently demanded a white horse from the patrol adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: A sorcerer of Qingcheng, riding the commotion, led his faction falsely claiming to be Vice Director Chen, stopped at an inn, and urgently demanded a white horse from the patrol adjutant.

sentences.zh: 馬步使瞿大夫覺其妄，執之，沃以狗血，即引服，悉誅之。

translations.literal: Cavalry and infantry commissioner Qu Dafu perceived the imposture, seized him, poured dog's blood over him, and he immediately confessed; all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry and infantry commissioner Qu Dafu perceived the imposture, seized him, poured dog's blood over him, and he immediately confessed; all were executed.

sentences.zh: 六月，庚寅，敬瑄至成都。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengyin, Jingxuan reached Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengyin, Jingxuan reached Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 黃巢別將陷睦州、婺州。

translations.literal: A separate commander of Huang Chao took Mu prefecture and Wu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A separate commander of Huang Chao took Mu prefecture and Wu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 盧攜病風不能行，謁告。

translations.literal: Lu Xie was ill with paralysis and could not walk, and requested leave.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xie was ill with paralysis and could not walk, and requested leave.

sentences.zh: 己亥，始入對，敕勿拜，遣二黃門掖之。

translations.literal: On jihai he first entered audience; an edict forbade bowing, and two yellow gate attendants supported him.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he first entered audience; an edict forbade bowing, and two yellow gate attendants supported him.

sentences.zh: 攜內挾田令孜，外倚高駢，上寵遇甚厚，由是專制朝政，高下在心。

translations.literal: Within, Xie relied on Tian Lingzi; without, he leaned on Gao Pian; the emperor favored him exceedingly, and thereby he monopolized court governance, deciding high and low as he pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Within, Xie relied on Tian Lingzi; without, he leaned on Gao Pian. The emperor favored him exceedingly, and thereby he monopolized court governance, deciding high and low as he pleased.

sentences.zh: 既病，精神不完，事之可否決於親吏楊溫、李修，貨賂公行。

translations.literal: Once ill, his mind was no longer whole; whether affairs should proceed fell to his personal clerks Yang Wen and Li Xiu, and bribes flowed openly.
translations.idiomatic: Once ill, his mind was no longer whole; whether affairs should proceed fell to his personal clerks Yang Wen and Li Xiu, and bribes flowed openly.

sentences.zh: 豆盧瑑無他材，專附會攜。

translations.literal: Dou Lu Zhuan had no other talent and devoted himself wholly to aligning with Xie.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Lu Zhuan had no other talent and devoted himself wholly to aligning with Xie.

sentences.zh: 崔沆時有啟陳，常為所沮。

translations.literal: Whenever Cui Hang submitted memorials of advice, Xie often blocked them.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Cui Hang submitted memorials of advice, Xie often blocked them.

sentences.zh: 庚子，李琢奏沙陀二千來降。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Li Zhuo memorialized that two thousand Shatuo had come to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Li Zhuo memorialized that two thousand Shatuo had come to surrender.

sentences.zh: 琢時將兵萬人屯代州，與盧龍節度使李可舉、吐谷渾都督赫連鐸共討沙陀。

translations.literal: Zhuo then commanded ten thousand troops encamped at Dai prefecture, and together with Lulong Military Governor Li Keju and Tuyuhun commander-in-chief Helian Duo jointly attacked the Shatuo.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo then commanded ten thousand troops encamped at Dai prefecture, and together with Lulong military governor Li Keju and Tuyuhun commander-in-chief Helian Duo jointly attacked the Shatuo.

sentences.zh: 李克用遣大將高文集守朔州，自將其眾拒可舉於雄武軍。

translations.literal: Li Keyong sent great general Gao Wenji to hold Shuo prefecture and himself led his host to oppose Keju at Xiongwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong sent great general Gao Wenji to hold Shuo prefecture and himself led his host to oppose Keju at Xiongwu Army.

sentences.zh: 鐸遣人說文集歸國，文集執克用將傅文達，與沙陀酋長李友金、薩葛都督米海萬、安慶都督史敬存皆降於琢，開門迎官軍。

translations.literal: Duo sent men to persuade Wenji to return to the state; Wenji seized Keyong's general Fu Wenda, and the Shatuo chieftain Li Youjin, Sagye commander-in-chief Mi Haiwan, and Anqing commander-in-chief Shi Jingcun all surrendered to Zhuo and opened the gates to welcome the government army.
translations.idiomatic: Duo sent men to persuade Wenji to return to the state. Wenji seized Keyong's general Fu Wenda, and the Shatuo chieftain Li Youjin, Sagye commander-in-chief Mi Haiwan, and Anqing commander-in-chief Shi Jingcun all surrendered to Zhuo and opened the gates to welcome the government army.

sentences.zh: 友金，克用之族父也。

translations.literal: Youjin was Keyong's clansman elder.
translations.idiomatic: Youjin was Keyong's clansman elder.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，黃巢攻宣州，陷之。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Huang Chao attacked Xuan prefecture and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Huang Chao attacked Xuan prefecture and took it.

sentences.zh: 劉漢宏南掠申、光。

translations.literal: Liu Hanhong raided south into Shen and Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hanhong raided south into Shen and Guang.

sentences.zh: 趙宗政之還南詔也，西川節度使崔安潛表以崔澹之說為是，且曰：「南詔小蠻，本雲南一郡之地。

translations.literal: When Zhao Zongzheng returned to Nanzhao, former Xichuan Military Governor Cui Anqian memorialized that Cui Tan's proposal was correct, and said: "Nanzhao is a small barbarian state, originally the territory of a single commandery in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Zongzheng returned to Nanzhao, former Xichuan military governor Cui Anqian memorialized that Cui Tan's proposal was correct, and said, "Nanzhao is a small barbarian state, originally the territory of a single commandery in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 今遣使與和，彼謂中國為怯，復求尚主，何以拒之！」

translations.literal: Now if we send envoys to make peace, they will take China for cowardly and again seek an imperial princess in marriage—how can we refuse!"
translations.idiomatic: Now if we send envoys to make peace, they will take China for cowardly and again seek an imperial princess in marriage—how can we refuse!

sentences.zh: 上命宰相議之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the grand councillors to discuss it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the grand councillors to discuss it.

sentences.zh: 盧攜、豆盧琢上言：「大中之末，府庫充實。

translations.literal: Lu Xie and Dou Lu Zhuan submitted a memorial: "At the end of the Dazhong era the treasuries were full.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xie and Dou Lu Zhuan submitted a memorial: "At the end of the Dazhong era the treasuries were full.

sentences.zh: 自咸通以來，蠻兩陷安南、邕管，一入黔中，四犯西川，徵兵運糧，天下疲弊，逾十五年，租賦太半不入京師，三使、內庫由茲虛竭。

translations.literal: From Xiantong onward the barbarians twice took Annan and Yong and Guan, once entered Qianzhong, and four times invaded Xichuan; mobilizing troops and transporting grain exhausted all under Heaven for more than fifteen years, and more than half of tax and tribute never reached the capital—the Three Offices and the inner treasury were thereby drained.
translations.idiomatic: From Xiantong onward the barbarians twice took Annan and Yong and Guan, once entered Qianzhong, and four times invaded Xichuan; mobilizing troops and transporting grain exhausted all under Heaven for more than fifteen years, and more than half of tax and tribute never reached the capital—the Three Offices and the inner treasury were thereby drained.

sentences.zh: 戰士死於瘴癘，百姓困為盜賊，致中原榛杞，皆蠻故也。

translations.literal: Soldiers died of miasma; the people were driven into banditry; the central plains were laid waste—all because of the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers died of miasma; the people were driven into banditry; the central plains were laid waste—all because of the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 前歲冬，蠻不為寇，由趙宗政未歸。

translations.literal: The winter before last the barbarians did not raid because Zhao Zongzheng had not yet returned.
translations.idiomatic: The winter before last the barbarians did not raid because Zhao Zongzheng had not yet returned.

sentences.zh: 去歲冬，蠻不為寇，由徐雲虔覆命，蠻尚有冀望。

translations.literal: Last winter the barbarians did not raid because Xu Yunqian had returned with the reply and the barbarians still had hope.
translations.idiomatic: Last winter the barbarians did not raid because Xu Yunqian had returned with the reply and the barbarians still had hope.

sentences.zh: 今安南子城為叛卒所據，節度使攻之未下，自餘戍卒，多已自歸，邕管客軍，又減其半。

translations.literal: Now the Annan sub-prefecture city is held by mutinous soldiers and the military governor has not yet taken it; of the remaining garrison troops most have already returned on their own, and the guest armies of Yong and Guan are again reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Annan sub-prefecture city is held by mutinous soldiers and the military governor has not yet taken it; of the remaining garrison troops most have already returned on their own, and the guest armies of Yong and Guan are again reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 冬期且至，倘蠻寇侵軼，何以枝梧！

translations.literal: Winter is near; if the barbarians raid and sweep across the borders, how can we resist!
translations.idiomatic: Winter is near; if the barbarians raid and sweep across the borders, how can we resist!

sentences.zh: 不若且遣使臣報復，縱未得其稱臣奉貢，且不使之懷怨益深，堅決犯邊，則可矣。」

translations.literal: Better for now to dispatch envoys with a reply; even if we do not obtain their submission and tribute, at least let them not harbor deeper resentment and resolutely violate the frontier—that will suffice."
translations.idiomatic: Better for now to dispatch envoys with a reply; even if we do not obtain their submission and tribute, at least let them not harbor deeper resentment and resolutely violate the frontier—that will suffice.

sentences.zh: 乃作詔賜陳敬瑄，許其和親，不稱臣，令敬瑄錄詔白，並移書與之，仍增賜金帛。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict was drafted for Chen Jingxuan, permitting marriage alliance without requiring them to call themselves subjects; Jingxuan was ordered to copy the edict in white and send a letter as well, with additional gifts of gold and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict was drafted for Chen Jingxuan, permitting marriage alliance without requiring them to call themselves subjects; Jingxuan was ordered to copy the edict in white and send a letter as well, with additional gifts of gold and silk.

sentences.zh: 以嗣曹王龜年為宗正少卿充使，以徐去虔為副使，別遣內使，共繼詣南詔。

translations.literal: Heir of the Prince of Cao Gui Nian was made Vice Director of the Imperial Clan and chief envoy, Xu Quqian deputy envoy; separately an inner attendant was dispatched to continue on to Nanzhao with them.
translations.idiomatic: Heir of the Prince of Cao Gui Nian was made vice director of the Imperial Clan and chief envoy, Xu Quqian deputy envoy; separately an inner attendant was dispatched to continue on to Nanzhao with them.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，黃巢自採石渡江，圍天長、六合，兵勢甚盛。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, Huang Chao crossed the river at Caishi, besieged Tianchang and Liuhe, and his military power was very strong.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, Huang Chao crossed the river at Caishi, besieged Tianchang and Liuhe, and his military power was very strong.

sentences.zh: 淮南將畢師鐸言於高駢曰：「朝廷倚公為安危，今賊數十萬眾乘勝長驅，若涉無人之境，不據險要之地以擊之，使逾長淮，不可復製，必為中原大患。」

translations.literal: Huainan general Bi Shiduo said to Gao Pian: "The court relies on you for its safety and peril; now the bandits, several hundred thousand strong, are driving forward on victory as if crossing an unpeopled land. If you do not hold strategic ground and strike them, letting them cross the Long Huai, they cannot be controlled again and will surely become a great calamity for the central plains."
translations.idiomatic: Huainan general Bi Shiduo said to Gao Pian, "The court relies on you for its safety and peril. Now the bandits, several hundred thousand strong, are driving forward on victory as if crossing an unpeopled land. If you do not hold strategic ground and strike them, letting them cross the Long Huai, they cannot be controlled again and will surely become a great calamity for the central plains.

sentences.zh: 駢以諸道兵已散，張璘復死，自度力不能制，畏怯不敢出兵，但命諸將嚴備，自保而已，且上表告急，稱：「賊六十餘萬屯天長，去臣城無五十里。」

translations.literal: Pian, because the armies of the various circuits had already dispersed and Zhang Lin had again died, reckoned he lacked the strength to control matters, was afraid and dared not send troops, but only ordered the generals to make strict preparations and protect themselves; he also submitted an urgent memorial saying: "Six hundred thousand bandits are encamped at Tianchang, less than fifty li from my city."
translations.idiomatic: Pian, because the armies of the various circuits had already dispersed and Zhang Lin had again died, reckoned he lacked the strength to control matters, was afraid and dared not send troops, but only ordered the generals to make strict preparations and protect themselves; he also submitted an urgent memorial saying, "Six hundred thousand bandits are encamped at Tianchang, less than fifty li from my city.

sentences.zh: 先是，盧攜謂「駢有文武長才，若悉委以兵柄，黃巢不足平。」

translations.literal: Earlier, Lu Xie had said that "Pian possessed both civil and military talent; if military authority were wholly entrusted to him, Huang Chao would not be hard to pacify."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Lu Xie had said that "Pian possessed both civil and military talent; if military authority were wholly entrusted to him, Huang Chao would not be hard to pacify.

sentences.zh: 朝野雖有謂駢不足恃者，然猶庶幾望之。

translations.literal: Although some in court and country said Pian could not be relied on, people still hoped in him somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Although some in court and country said Pian could not be relied on, people still hoped in him somewhat.

sentences.zh: 乃駢表至，上下失望，人情大駭。

translations.literal: Now when Pian's memorial arrived, high and low lost hope and public sentiment was greatly terrified.
translations.idiomatic: Now when Pian's memorial arrived, high and low lost hope and public sentiment was greatly terrified.

sentences.zh: 詔書責駢散遣諸道兵，致賊乘無備渡江。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Pian for dispersing the armies of the various circuits, causing the bandits to cross the river while he was unprepared.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Pian for dispersing the armies of the various circuits, causing the bandits to cross the river while he was unprepared.

sentences.zh: 駢上表言：「臣奏聞遣歸，亦非自專。

translations.literal: Pian submitted a memorial saying: "When I memorialized reporting their dispatch for return, it was not my own sole decision either.
translations.idiomatic: Pian submitted a memorial saying, "When I memorialized reporting their dispatch for return, it was not my own sole decision either.

sentences.zh: 今臣竭力保衛一方，必能濟辦。

translations.literal: Now I am exerting my strength to defend one region and can surely manage it.
translations.idiomatic: Now I am exerting my strength to defend one region and can surely manage it.

sentences.zh: 但恐賊迤邐過淮，宜急敕東道將士善為御備。」

translations.literal: But I fear the bandits will wind past the Huai; the eastern circuit officers and soldiers should urgently be ordered to make good defensive preparations."
translations.idiomatic: But I fear the bandits will wind past the Huai; the eastern circuit officers and soldiers should urgently be ordered to make good defensive preparations.

sentences.zh: 遂稱風痺，不復出戰。

translations.literal: Thereupon he claimed rheumatism and no longer went out to battle.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he claimed rheumatism and no longer went out to battle.

sentences.zh: 詔河南諸道發兵屯殷水，泰寧節度使齊克讓屯汝州，以備黃巢。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the circuits south of the Yellow River to mobilize troops and encamp at Yinshui; Taining Military Governor Qi Kerang encamped at Ru prefecture to guard against Huang Chao.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the circuits south of the Yellow River to mobilize troops and encamp at Yinshui; Taining military governor Qi Kerang encamped at Ru prefecture to guard against Huang Chao.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以淄州刺史曹全晸為天平節度使、兼東面副都統。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Zi Prefect Cao Quanzhen was made military governor of Tianping and concurrently eastern deputy overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zi prefect Cao Quanzhen was made military governor of Tianping and concurrently eastern deputy overall commander.

sentences.zh: 劉漢宏請降。

translations.literal: Liu Hanhong requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hanhong requested surrender.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以為宿州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuchen, he was made prefect of Su.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, he was made prefect of Su.

sentences.zh: 李克用自雄武軍引兵還，擊高文集於朔州，李可舉遣行軍司馬韓玄紹邀之於藥兒嶺，大破之，殺七千餘人，李盡忠、程懷信皆死；

translations.literal: Li Keyong withdrew his troops from Xiongwu Army and struck Gao Wenji at Shuo prefecture; Li Keju sent expeditionary deputy Han Xuanshao to intercept him at Yao'er Ridge and routed him, killing more than seven thousand; Li Jinzhong and Cheng Huaijin both died;
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong withdrew his troops from Xiongwu Army and struck Gao Wenji at Shuo prefecture. Li Keju sent expeditionary deputy Han Xuanshao to intercept him at Yao'er Ridge and routed him, killing more than seven thousand; Li Jinzhong and Cheng Huaijin both died.

sentences.zh: 又敗之於雄武軍之境，殺萬人。

translations.literal: He was again defeated within the borders of Xiongwu Army, and ten thousand were killed.
translations.idiomatic: He was again defeated within the borders of Xiongwu Army, and ten thousand were killed.

sentences.zh: 李琢、赫連鐸進攻蔚州，李國昌戰敗，部眾皆潰，獨與克用及宗族北入達靼。

translations.literal: Li Zhuo and Helian Duo pressed the attack on Yu prefecture; Li Guochang was defeated in battle, his followers all scattered, and he alone with Keyong and their clan entered the north among the Tatars.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhuo and Helian Duo pressed the attack on Yu prefecture. Li Guochang was defeated in battle, his followers all scattered, and he alone with Keyong and their clan entered the north among the Tatars.

sentences.zh: 詔以鐸為雲州刺史、大同軍防禦使，吐谷渾白義成為蔚州刺史，薩葛米海萬為朔州刺史，加李可舉兼侍中。

translations.literal: An edict made Duo prefect of Yun and defensive commissioner of the Datong Army, Bai Yicheng prefect of Yu, Mi Haiwan of the Sagye prefect of Shuo, and added Li Keju as Palace Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Duo prefect of Yun and defensive commissioner of the Datong Army, Bai Yicheng prefect of Yu, Mi Haiwan of the Sagye prefect of Shuo, and added Li Keju as palace secretary.

sentences.zh: 達靼本靺羯之別部也，居於陰山。

translations.literal: The Tatars were originally a separate branch of the Mohe and dwelt in the Yin Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The Tatars were originally a separate branch of the Mohe and dwelt in the Yin Mountains.

sentences.zh: 後數月，赫連鐸陰賂達靼，使取李國昌父子，李克用知之。

translations.literal: Several months later Helian Duo secretly bribed the Tatars to seize Li Guochang and his son; Keyong learned of it.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later Helian Duo secretly bribed the Tatars to seize Li Guochang and his son; Keyong learned of it.

sentences.zh: 時與其豪帥遊獵，置馬鞭、木葉或懸針，射之無不中，豪帥心服。

translations.literal: At the time he was hunting with their chieftains; he would set up a horsewhip, a tree leaf, or hang a needle and shoot without missing, and the chieftains were impressed in heart.
translations.idiomatic: At the time he was hunting with their chieftains; he would set up a horsewhip, a tree leaf, or hang a needle and shoot without missing, and the chieftains were impressed in heart.

sentences.zh: 又置酒與飲，酒酣，克用言曰：「吾得罪天子，願效忠而不得。

translations.literal: He again set out wine for them to drink; when the wine was warm, Keyong said: "I have offended Heaven's Son and wish to show loyalty yet cannot.
translations.idiomatic: He again set out wine for them to drink. When the wine was warm, Keyong said, "I have offended Heaven's Son and wish to show loyalty yet cannot.

sentences.zh: 今聞黃巢北來，必為中原患，一旦天子若赦吾罪，得與公輩南向共立大功，不亦快乎！

translations.literal: Now I hear Huang Chao is coming north and will surely become a calamity for the central plains; if Heaven's Son should one day pardon my crime and I can turn south with you all to establish great merit together, would that not be a joy!
translations.idiomatic: Now I hear Huang Chao is coming north and will surely become a calamity for the central plains. If Heaven's Son should one day pardon my crime and I can turn south with you all to establish great merit together, would that not be a joy!

sentences.zh: 人生幾何，誰能老死沙磧邪！」

translations.literal: How many years does a man live—who can die old in the desert sands!"
translations.idiomatic: How many years does a man live—who can die old in the desert sands!

sentences.zh: 達靼知無留意，乃止。

translations.literal: The Tatars knew he had no intention of staying and therefore stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The Tatars knew he had no intention of staying and therefore stopped.

sentences.zh: 八月，甲午，以前西川節度使崔安潛為太子賓客、分司。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiawu, former Xichuan Military Governor Cui Anqian was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent with fractional duty at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiawu, former Xichuan military governor Cui Anqian was made grand preceptor of the heir apparent with fractional duty at the capital.

sentences.zh: 九月，東都奏：「汝州所募軍李光庭等五百人自代州還，過東都，燒安喜門，焚掠市肆，由長夏門去。」

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the eastern capital reported: "Five hundred men recruited at Ru prefecture—Li Guangting and others—returning from Dai prefecture passed the eastern capital, burned the Anxi Gate, plundered the markets, and departed through the Changxia Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the eastern capital reported, "Five hundred men recruited at Ru prefecture—Li Guangting and others—returning from Dai prefecture passed the eastern capital, burned the Anxi Gate, plundered the markets, and departed through the Changxia Gate.

sentences.zh: 黃巢眾號十五萬，曹全晸以其眾六千與之戰，頗有殺獲。

translations.literal: Huang Chao's host was said to number one hundred fifty thousand; Cao Quanzhen fought them with his host of six thousand and killed and captured a fair number.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao's host was said to number one hundred fifty thousand; Cao Quanzhen fought them with his host of six thousand and killed and captured a fair number.

sentences.zh: 以眾寡不敵，退屯泗上，以俟諸軍至，並力擊之。

translations.literal: Finding his numbers unequal to theirs, he withdrew to encamp on the Si River to wait until the various armies arrived and could strike together with combined strength.
translations.idiomatic: Finding his numbers unequal to theirs, he withdrew to encamp on the Si River to wait until the various armies arrived and could strike together with combined strength.

sentences.zh: 而高駢竟不之救，賊遂擊全晸，破之。

translations.literal: But Gao Pian in the end did not rescue him, and the bandits then struck Quanzhen and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: But Gao Pian in the end did not rescue him, and the bandits then struck Quanzhen and routed him.

sentences.zh: 徐州遣兵三千赴殷水，過許昌。

translations.literal: Xuzhou dispatched three thousand troops to Yinshui, passing through Xuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou dispatched three thousand troops to Yinshui, passing through Xuchang.

sentences.zh: 徐卒素名凶悖，節度使薛能，自謂前鎮彭城，有恩信於徐人，館之球場。

translations.literal: The Xuzhou soldiers had always been notorious for violence; Military Governor Xue Neng, trusting that he had formerly governed Pengcheng and had kindness and faith among the men of Xu, quartered them on the ball field.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuzhou soldiers had always been notorious for violence; military governor Xue Neng, trusting that he had formerly governed Pengcheng and had kindness and faith among the men of Xu, quartered them on the ball field.

sentences.zh: 及暮，徐卒大噪，能登子城樓問之，對以供備疏闕，慰勞久之，方定。

translations.literal: At dusk the Xuzhou soldiers raised a great clamor; Neng mounted the inner city tower to ask the reason; they answered that supplies were deficient; he comforted them for a long time before they settled.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk the Xuzhou soldiers raised a great clamor. Neng mounted the inner city tower to ask the reason; they answered that supplies were deficient; he comforted them for a long time before they settled.

sentences.zh: 許人大懼。

translations.literal: The people of Xu were greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xu were greatly afraid.

sentences.zh: 時忠武亦遣大將周岌詣殷水，行未遠，聞之，夜，引兵還，比明，入城，襲擊徐卒，盡殺之。

translations.literal: At the time Zhongwu also sent great general Zhou Ji toward Yinshui; he had not gone far when he heard of it; by night he led troops back, and at dawn entered the city and attacked the Xuzhou soldiers, killing them all.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhongwu also sent great general Zhou Ji toward Yinshui; he had not gone far when he heard of it. By night he led troops back, and at dawn entered the city and attacked the Xuzhou soldiers, killing them all.

sentences.zh: 且怨能之厚徐卒也，遂逐之。

translations.literal: They also resented Neng for treating the Xuzhou soldiers generously and drove him out.
translations.idiomatic: They also resented Neng for treating the Xuzhou soldiers generously and drove him out.

sentences.zh: 能將奔襄陽，亂兵追殺之，並其家。
