translations.literal: Neng was about to flee to Xiangyang; the mutinous soldiers pursued and killed him, together with his family.
translations.idiomatic: Neng was about to flee to Xiangyang; the mutinous soldiers pursued and killed him, together with his family.

sentences.zh: 岌自稱留後。

translations.literal: Ji declared himself acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ji declared himself acting governor.

sentences.zh: 汝、鄭把截制置使齊克讓恐為岌所襲，引兵還兗州，於是，諸道屯殷水者皆散。

translations.literal: Yu and Zheng Interdiction and Pacification Commissioner Qi Kerang, fearing attack by Ji, led troops back to Yan prefecture; thereupon the various circuits encamped at Yinshui all dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Yu and Zheng interdiction and pacification commissioner Qi Kerang, fearing attack by Ji, led troops back to Yan prefecture; thereupon the various circuits encamped at Yinshui all dispersed.

sentences.zh: 黃巢遂悉眾渡淮，所過不虜掠，惟取丁壯以益兵。

translations.literal: Huang Chao then led his entire host across the Huai; wherever he passed he did not plunder, but only took strong young men to increase his army.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao then led his entire host across the Huai; wherever he passed he did not plunder, but only took strong young men to increase his army.

sentences.zh: 先是征振武節度使吳師泰為左金吾大將軍，以諸葛爽代之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zhenwu Military Governor Wu Shitai had been summoned as Left Golden Guard General, with Zhuge Shuang replacing him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Zhenwu military governor Wu Shitai had been summoned as Left Golden Guard General, with Zhuge Shuang replacing him.

sentences.zh: 師泰見朝廷多故，使軍民上表留己。

translations.literal: Shitai saw that the court faced many troubles and had the army and people submit a memorial asking that he be kept.
translations.idiomatic: Shitai saw that the court faced many troubles and had the army and people submit a memorial asking that he be kept.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，復以師泰為振武節度使，以爽為夏綏節度使。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, Shitai was again made military governor of Zhenwu, and Shuang military governor of Xia and Sui.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, Shitai was again made military governor of Zhenwu, and Shuang military governor of Xia and Sui.

sentences.zh: 黃巢陷申州，遂入穎、宋、徐、兗之境，所至吏民逃潰。

translations.literal: Huang Chao took Shen prefecture, then entered the territories of Ying, Song, Xu, and Yan; wherever he went officials and people fled and collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chao took Shen prefecture, then entered the territories of Ying, Song, Xu, and Yan; wherever he went officials and people fled and collapsed.

sentences.zh: 群盜陷澧州，殺刺史李詢、判官皇甫鎮。

translations.literal: Bandit hosts took Li prefecture and killed Prefect Li Xun and administrative judge Huangfu Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit hosts took Li prefecture and killed Prefect Li Xun and administrative judge Huangfu Zhen.

sentences.zh: 鎮舉進士二十三上，不中第，詢辟之。

translations.literal: Zhen had presented himself for the jinshi examination twenty-three times without passing; Xun had recruited him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen had presented himself for the jinshi examination twenty-three times without passing; Xun had recruited him.

sentences.zh: 賊至，城陷，鎮走，問人曰：「使君免乎？」

translations.literal: When the bandits arrived the city fell; Zhen fled and asked someone: "Has the prefect escaped?"
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits arrived the city fell; Zhen fled and asked someone, "Has the prefect escaped?

sentences.zh: 曰：「賊執之矣。」

translations.literal: He said: "The bandits have seized him."
translations.idiomatic: He said, "The bandits have seized him.

sentences.zh: 鎮曰：「吾受知若此，去將何之！」

translations.literal: Zhen said: "I received his trust to this extent—where would I go!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhen said, "I received his trust to this extent—where would I go!

sentences.zh: 遂還詣賊，竟與同死。

translations.literal: Thereupon he returned to seek out the bandits and in the end died together with Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he returned to seek out the bandits and in the end died together with Xun.
